---- MODULE OpenAddressing ----
EXTENDS OpenAddressingDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL AgT == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL AgFST == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems
LOCAL AgFSX == INSTANCE FiniteSetsExtTheorems
LOCAL AgST == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems

(***************************************************************************)
(* Bridges between operators imported through EXTENDS and their            *)
(* counterparts re-exported by the instantiated library modules.           *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA AgCardBridge == \A S : AgFST!Cardinality(S) = Cardinality(S)
  BY DEF AgFST!Cardinality, Cardinality

LEMMA AgFinBridge == \A S : AgFST!IsFiniteSet(S) <=> IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY DEF AgFST!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet

LEMMA AgFinBridgeX == \A S : AgFSX!IsFiniteSet(S) <=> IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY DEF AgFSX!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet

(***************************************************************************)
(* Elementary consequences of the constant assumptions.                    *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA AgTwoDistinct == \E a, b \in fps : a # b
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME \A a, b \in fps : a = b PROVE FALSE
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. IsFiniteSet(fps) /\ Cardinality(fps) > 1
  BY OAAssumption
<1>2. CASE fps = {}
  <2>1. Cardinality({}) = 0
    BY AgFST!FS_EmptySet, AgCardBridge
  <2>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, <2>1
<1>3. CASE fps # {}
  <2>1. PICK a \in fps : TRUE
    BY <1>3
  <2>2. fps = {a}
    BY <2>1
  <2>3. Cardinality({a}) = 1
    BY AgFST!FS_Singleton, AgCardBridge
  <2>. QED  BY <1>1, <2>2, <2>3
<1>. QED  BY <1>2, <1>3

LEMMA AgMaxMin ==
  /\ max(fps) \in fps
  /\ min(fps) \in fps
  /\ \A y \in fps : min(fps) <= y /\ y <= max(fps)
  /\ min(fps) \in Nat /\ max(fps) \in Nat
  /\ max(fps) - min(fps) \in Nat \ {0}
<1>1. fps \in SUBSET Int /\ fps # {} /\ IsFiniteSet(fps)
  BY OAAssumption, AgTwoDistinct
<1>2. max(fps) \in fps /\ \A y \in fps : max(fps) >= y
  BY <1>1, AgFSX!MaxIntFinite, AgFinBridgeX DEF max, AgFSX!Max
<1>3. min(fps) \in fps /\ \A y \in fps : min(fps) <= y
  BY <1>1, AgFSX!MinIntFinite, AgFinBridgeX DEF min, AgFSX!Min
<1>4. PICK a, b \in fps : a # b
  BY AgTwoDistinct
<1>5. min(fps) \in Nat /\ max(fps) \in Nat /\ a \in Nat /\ b \in Nat
  BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, OAAssumption
<1>6. max(fps) - min(fps) \in Nat \ {0}
  BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>. QED  BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>5, <1>6

LEMMA AgModRange == \A i \in Int : mod(i, K) \in 1..K
  BY OAAssumption, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF mod

LEMMA AgIdxRange == \A f, pz \in Int : idx(f, pz) \in 1..K
<1>1. max(fps) - min(fps) \in Nat \ {0} /\ min(fps) \in Nat
  BY AgMaxMin
<1>2. (K - 1) \div (max(fps) - min(fps)) \in Int
  BY <1>1, OAAssumption
<1>3. \A f, pz \in Int : ((K-1) \div (max(fps) - min(fps))) * (f - min(fps) + 1) + pz \in Int
  BY <1>1, <1>2
<1>. QED  BY <1>3, AgModRange DEF idx, rescale

(***************************************************************************)
(* Strictly increasing sequences and the properties of SelectSeq that are  *)
(* needed to reason about the external log.                                *)
(***************************************************************************)
AgSIncr(q) == \A a, b \in 1..Len(q) : a < b => q[a] < q[b]

LEMMA AgSelSeqRec ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW s \in Seq(S), NEW e \in S, NEW Test(_)
  PROVE  SelectSeq(Append(s, e), Test)
           = IF Test(e) THEN Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e) ELSE SelectSeq(s, Test)
  BY AgT!SMTT("r30")

LEMMA AgSelSeqEmpty ==
  ASSUME NEW Test(_)
  PROVE  SelectSeq(<< >>, Test) = << >>
  BY AgT!SMTT("r30")

LEMMA AgSelSeq ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW Test(_)
  PROVE  \A q \in Seq(S) :
           AgSIncr(q) =>
             /\ SelectSeq(q, Test) \in Seq(S)
             /\ AgSIncr(SelectSeq(q, Test))
             /\ \A j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(q, Test)) :
                  \E k \in 1..Len(q) : SelectSeq(q, Test)[j] = q[k] /\ Test(q[k])
<1> DEFINE P(q) == AgSIncr(q) =>
                     /\ SelectSeq(q, Test) \in Seq(S)
                     /\ AgSIncr(SelectSeq(q, Test))
                     /\ \A j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(q, Test)) :
                          \E k \in 1..Len(q) : SelectSeq(q, Test)[j] = q[k] /\ Test(q[k])
<1>1. P(<< >>)
  <2>1. SelectSeq(<< >>, Test) = << >>
    BY AgSelSeqEmpty
  <2>2. Len(<< >>) = 0 /\ << >> \in Seq(S)
    BY AgST!EmptySeq
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <2>2 DEF AgSIncr
<1>2. \A s \in Seq(S), e \in S : P(s) => P(Append(s, e))
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(S), NEW e \in S, P(s), AgSIncr(Append(s, e))
               PROVE  /\ SelectSeq(Append(s, e), Test) \in Seq(S)
                      /\ AgSIncr(SelectSeq(Append(s, e), Test))
                      /\ \A j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(Append(s, e), Test)) :
                           \E k \in 1..Len(Append(s, e)) :
                              SelectSeq(Append(s, e), Test)[j] = Append(s, e)[k]
                              /\ Test(Append(s, e)[k])
    OBVIOUS
  <2>ls. Len(s) \in Nat /\ s \in [1..Len(s) -> S]
    BY AgST!LenProperties
  <2>ap. /\ Append(s, e) \in Seq(S)
         /\ Len(Append(s, e)) = Len(s) + 1
         /\ \A i \in 1..Len(s) : Append(s, e)[i] = s[i]
         /\ Append(s, e)[Len(s)+1] = e
    BY AgST!AppendProperties
  <2>si. AgSIncr(s)
    BY <2>ap, <2>ls DEF AgSIncr
  <2>ps. /\ SelectSeq(s, Test) \in Seq(S)
         /\ AgSIncr(SelectSeq(s, Test))
         /\ \A j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test)) :
              \E k \in 1..Len(s) : SelectSeq(s, Test)[j] = s[k] /\ Test(s[k])
    BY <2>si
  <2>lr. Len(SelectSeq(s, Test)) \in Nat
    BY <2>ps, AgST!LenProperties
  <2>1. CASE ~Test(e)
    <3>1. SelectSeq(Append(s, e), Test) = SelectSeq(s, Test)
      BY AgSelSeqRec, <2>1
    <3>2. \A j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(Append(s, e), Test)) :
             \E k \in 1..Len(Append(s, e)) :
                SelectSeq(Append(s, e), Test)[j] = Append(s, e)[k] /\ Test(Append(s, e)[k])
      <4>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))
                     PROVE  \E k \in 1..Len(s)+1 :
                               SelectSeq(s, Test)[j] = Append(s, e)[k] /\ Test(Append(s, e)[k])
        BY <3>1, <2>ap
      <4>2. PICK k \in 1..Len(s) : SelectSeq(s, Test)[j] = s[k] /\ Test(s[k])
        BY <2>ps
      <4>. QED  BY <4>2, <2>ap, <2>ls
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1, <3>2, <2>ps
  <2>2. CASE Test(e)
    <3>1. SelectSeq(Append(s, e), Test) = Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)
      BY AgSelSeqRec, <2>2
    <3>2. /\ Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e) \in Seq(S)
          /\ Len(Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)) = Len(SelectSeq(s, Test)) + 1
          /\ \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test)) :
                Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)[i] = SelectSeq(s, Test)[i]
          /\ Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)[Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))+1] = e
      BY <2>ps, AgST!AppendProperties
    <3>lt. \A j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test)) : SelectSeq(s, Test)[j] < e
      <4>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))
                     PROVE  SelectSeq(s, Test)[j] < e
        OBVIOUS
      <4>2. PICK k \in 1..Len(s) : SelectSeq(s, Test)[j] = s[k] /\ Test(s[k])
        BY <2>ps
      <4>3. Append(s, e)[k] = s[k] /\ Append(s, e)[Len(s)+1] = e
        BY <4>2, <2>ap
      <4>4. k \in 1..Len(Append(s, e)) /\ (Len(s)+1) \in 1..Len(Append(s, e)) /\ k < Len(s)+1
        BY <4>2, <2>ap, <2>ls
      <4>. QED  BY <4>2, <4>3, <4>4 DEF AgSIncr
    <3>3. AgSIncr(Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e))
      <4>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW a \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))+1,
                            NEW b \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))+1, a < b
                     PROVE  Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)[a] < Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)[b]
        BY <3>2 DEF AgSIncr
      <4>2. a \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))
        BY <4>1, <2>lr
      <4>3. CASE b = Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))+1
        BY <4>2, <4>3, <3>2, <3>lt
      <4>4. CASE b \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))
        BY <4>1, <4>2, <4>4, <3>2, <2>ps DEF AgSIncr
      <4>. QED  BY <4>1, <4>3, <4>4, <2>lr
    <3>4. \A j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(Append(s, e), Test)) :
             \E k \in 1..Len(Append(s, e)) :
                SelectSeq(Append(s, e), Test)[j] = Append(s, e)[k] /\ Test(Append(s, e)[k])
      <4>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))+1
                     PROVE  \E k \in 1..Len(s)+1 :
                               Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)[j] = Append(s, e)[k]
                               /\ Test(Append(s, e)[k])
        BY <3>1, <3>2, <2>ap
      <4>2. CASE j = Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))+1
        <5>1. Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)[j] = e
          BY <4>2, <3>2
        <5>. QED  BY <5>1, <2>ap, <2>2, <2>ls
      <4>3. CASE j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))
        <5>1. PICK k \in 1..Len(s) : SelectSeq(s, Test)[j] = s[k] /\ Test(s[k])
          BY <4>3, <2>ps
        <5>2. Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)[j] = SelectSeq(s, Test)[j]
          BY <4>3, <3>2
        <5>. QED  BY <5>1, <5>2, <2>ap, <2>ls
      <4>. QED  BY <4>1, <4>2, <4>3, <2>lr
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, <3>4
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, AgST!SequencesInductionAppend

LEMMA AgSelSeqIn ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW Test(_)
  PROVE  \A q \in Seq(S) :
            /\ SelectSeq(q, Test) \in Seq(S)
            /\ \A k \in 1..Len(q) :
                  Test(q[k]) =>
                     \E j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(q, Test)) : SelectSeq(q, Test)[j] = q[k]
<1> DEFINE P(q) == /\ SelectSeq(q, Test) \in Seq(S)
                   /\ \A k \in 1..Len(q) :
                         Test(q[k]) =>
                            \E j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(q, Test)) :
                               SelectSeq(q, Test)[j] = q[k]
<1>1. P(<< >>)
  <2>1. SelectSeq(<< >>, Test) = << >>
    BY AgSelSeqEmpty
  <2>2. Len(<< >>) = 0 /\ << >> \in Seq(S)
    BY AgST!EmptySeq
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>2. \A s \in Seq(S), e \in S : P(s) => P(Append(s, e))
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(S), NEW e \in S, P(s)
               PROVE  P(Append(s, e))
    OBVIOUS
  <2>ls. Len(s) \in Nat
    BY AgST!LenProperties
  <2>ap. /\ Append(s, e) \in Seq(S)
         /\ Len(Append(s, e)) = Len(s) + 1
         /\ \A i \in 1..Len(s) : Append(s, e)[i] = s[i]
         /\ Append(s, e)[Len(s)+1] = e
    BY AgST!AppendProperties
  <2>sr. SelectSeq(Append(s, e), Test)
           = IF Test(e) THEN Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e) ELSE SelectSeq(s, Test)
    BY AgSelSeqRec
  <2>lr. Len(SelectSeq(s, Test)) \in Nat
    BY AgST!LenProperties
  <2>1. CASE Test(e)
    <3>1. SelectSeq(Append(s, e), Test) = Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)
      BY <2>sr, <2>1
    <3>2. /\ Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e) \in Seq(S)
          /\ Len(Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)) = Len(SelectSeq(s, Test)) + 1
          /\ \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test)) :
                Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)[i] = SelectSeq(s, Test)[i]
          /\ Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)[Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))+1] = e
      BY AgST!AppendProperties
    <3>3. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW k \in 1..(Len(s)+1), Test(Append(s, e)[k])
                   PROVE  \E j \in 1..(Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))+1) :
                             Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)[j] = Append(s, e)[k]
      BY <3>1, <3>2, <2>ap
    <3>4. CASE k = Len(s)+1
      <4>1. Append(s, e)[k] = e
        BY <3>4, <2>ap
      <4>2. Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)[Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))+1] = e
            /\ Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))+1 \in 1..(Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))+1)
        BY <3>2, <2>lr
      <4>. QED  BY <4>1, <4>2
    <3>5. CASE k \in 1..Len(s)
      <4>1. Append(s, e)[k] = s[k] /\ Test(s[k])
        BY <3>5, <2>ap, <3>3
      <4>2. PICK j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test)) : SelectSeq(s, Test)[j] = s[k]
        BY <4>1, <3>5
      <4>3. Append(SelectSeq(s, Test), e)[j] = SelectSeq(s, Test)[j]
        BY <4>2, <3>2
      <4>4. j \in 1..(Len(SelectSeq(s, Test))+1)
        BY <4>2, <2>lr
      <4>. QED  BY <4>1, <4>2, <4>3, <4>4
    <3>. QED  BY <3>3, <3>4, <3>5, <2>ls
  <2>2. CASE ~Test(e)
    <3>1. SelectSeq(Append(s, e), Test) = SelectSeq(s, Test)
      BY <2>sr, <2>2
    <3>2. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW k \in 1..(Len(s)+1), Test(Append(s, e)[k])
                   PROVE  \E j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test)) :
                             SelectSeq(s, Test)[j] = Append(s, e)[k]
      BY <3>1, <2>ap
    <3>3. k # Len(s)+1
      BY <3>2, <2>ap, <2>2
    <3>4. k \in 1..Len(s) /\ Append(s, e)[k] = s[k] /\ Test(s[k])
      BY <3>2, <3>3, <2>ap, <2>ls
    <3>. QED  BY <3>4
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, AgST!SequencesInductionAppend

LEMMA AgFpsInt == fps \subseteq Int
  BY OAAssumption

LEMMA AgSelSeqF ==
  ASSUME NEW Test(_)
  PROVE  \A q \in Seq(fps) :
           AgSIncr(q) =>
             /\ SelectSeq(q, Test) \in Seq(fps)
             /\ AgSIncr(SelectSeq(q, Test))
             /\ \A j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(q, Test)) :
                  \E k \in 1..Len(q) : SelectSeq(q, Test)[j] = q[k] /\ Test(q[k])
  BY AgSelSeq

LEMMA AgSelSmaller ==
  ASSUME NEW c, NEW d, NEW q \in Seq(fps), AgSIncr(q)
  PROVE  /\ SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA pz : pz < c /\ pz > d) \in Seq(fps)
         /\ AgSIncr(SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA pz : pz < c /\ pz > d))
         /\ \A j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA pz : pz < c /\ pz > d)) :
              \E k \in 1..Len(q) :
                 SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA pz : pz < c /\ pz > d)[j] = q[k] /\ q[k] < c /\ q[k] > d
<1> DEFINE MyT(pz) == pz < c /\ pz > d
<1>1. \A qq \in Seq(fps) :
        AgSIncr(qq) =>
          /\ SelectSeq(qq, MyT) \in Seq(fps)
          /\ AgSIncr(SelectSeq(qq, MyT))
          /\ \A j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(qq, MyT)) :
               \E k \in 1..Len(qq) : SelectSeq(qq, MyT)[j] = qq[k] /\ MyT(qq[k])
  BY AgSelSeqF
<1>. QED  BY <1>1

LEMMA AgSelLarger ==
  ASSUME NEW d, NEW q \in Seq(fps), AgSIncr(q)
  PROVE  /\ SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA pz : pz > d) \in Seq(fps)
         /\ AgSIncr(SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA pz : pz > d))
         /\ \A j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA pz : pz > d)) :
              \E k \in 1..Len(q) : SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA pz : pz > d)[j] = q[k] /\ q[k] > d
<1> DEFINE MyT(pz) == pz > d
<1>1. \A qq \in Seq(fps) :
        AgSIncr(qq) =>
          /\ SelectSeq(qq, MyT) \in Seq(fps)
          /\ AgSIncr(SelectSeq(qq, MyT))
          /\ \A j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(qq, MyT)) :
               \E k \in 1..Len(qq) : SelectSeq(qq, MyT)[j] = qq[k] /\ MyT(qq[k])
  BY AgSelSeqF
<1>. QED  BY <1>1

LEMMA AgSelNonEmpty ==
  ASSUME NEW q \in Seq(fps), AgSIncr(q)
  PROVE  /\ SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA e : e # empty) \in Seq(fps)
         /\ AgSIncr(SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA e : e # empty))
<1> DEFINE MyT(pz) == pz # empty
<1>1. \A qq \in Seq(fps) :
        AgSIncr(qq) =>
          /\ SelectSeq(qq, MyT) \in Seq(fps)
          /\ AgSIncr(SelectSeq(qq, MyT))
          /\ \A j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(qq, MyT)) :
               \E k \in 1..Len(qq) : SelectSeq(qq, MyT)[j] = qq[k] /\ MyT(qq[k])
  BY AgSelSeqF
<1>. QED  BY <1>1

LEMMA AgIsSorted ==
  ASSUME NEW q \in Seq(fps), AgSIncr(q)
  PROVE  isSorted(q)
<1>1. /\ SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA e : e # empty) \in Seq(fps)
      /\ AgSIncr(SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA e : e # empty))
  BY AgSelNonEmpty
<1>2. Len(SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA e : e # empty)) \in Nat
  BY <1>1, AgST!LenProperties
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF isSorted, AgSIncr

LEMMA AgLargestElem ==
  ASSUME NEW q \in Seq(fps), AgSIncr(q)
  PROVE  /\ largestElem(q) \in Nat
         /\ \A i \in 1..Len(q) : q[i] <= largestElem(q)
<1>1. Len(q) \in Nat /\ q \in [1..Len(q) -> fps]
  BY AgST!LenProperties
<1>2. CASE q = << >>
  <2>1. largestElem(q) = 0
    BY <1>2 DEF largestElem
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <1>2, AgST!EmptySeq
<1>3. CASE q # << >>
  <2>1. Len(q) \in Nat \ {0}
    BY <1>3, AgST!EmptySeq
  <2>2. largestElem(q) = q[Len(q)]
    BY <1>3 DEF largestElem, last
  <2>3. q[Len(q)] \in fps /\ q[Len(q)] \in Nat
    BY <2>1, <1>1, OAAssumption
  <2>4. \A i \in 1..Len(q) : q[i] <= q[Len(q)]
    <3>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(q) PROVE q[i] <= q[Len(q)]
      OBVIOUS
    <3>2. q[i] \in Nat /\ Len(q) \in 1..Len(q)
      BY <3>1, <2>1, <1>1, OAAssumption
    <3>3. i < Len(q) => q[i] < q[Len(q)]
      BY <3>1, <2>1 DEF AgSIncr
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, <2>3
  <2>. QED  BY <2>2, <2>3, <2>4
<1>. QED  BY <1>2, <1>3

LEMMA AgConcatOK ==
  ASSUME NEW a \in Seq(fps), NEW b \in Seq(fps), AgSIncr(a), AgSIncr(b),
         \A i \in 1..Len(a) : \A j \in 1..Len(b) : a[i] < b[j]
  PROVE  /\ a \o b \in Seq(fps)
         /\ AgSIncr(a \o b)
         /\ Len(a \o b) = Len(a) + Len(b)
         /\ \A i \in 1..Len(a \o b) : (a \o b)[i] = IF i <= Len(a) THEN a[i] ELSE b[i - Len(a)]
<1>1. Len(a) \in Nat /\ Len(b) \in Nat
  BY AgST!LenProperties
<1>2. /\ a \o b \in Seq(fps)
      /\ Len(a \o b) = Len(a) + Len(b)
      /\ \A i \in 1 .. Len(a) + Len(b) :
            (a \o b)[i] = IF i <= Len(a) THEN a[i] ELSE b[i - Len(a)]
  BY AgST!ConcatProperties
<1>3. AgSIncr(a \o b)
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW x \in 1..Len(a \o b), NEW y \in 1..Len(a \o b), x < y
                 PROVE  (a \o b)[x] < (a \o b)[y]
    BY DEF AgSIncr
  <2>2. x \in 1..(Len(a)+Len(b)) /\ y \in 1..(Len(a)+Len(b))
    BY <2>1, <1>2
  <2>3. CASE x <= Len(a) /\ y <= Len(a)
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <1>2, <1>1 DEF AgSIncr
  <2>4. CASE x <= Len(a) /\ ~(y <= Len(a))
    <3>1. x \in 1..Len(a) /\ (y - Len(a)) \in 1..Len(b)
      BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>4, <1>1
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1, <2>2, <2>4, <1>2
  <2>5. CASE ~(x <= Len(a)) /\ ~(y <= Len(a))
    <3>1. (x - Len(a)) \in 1..Len(b) /\ (y - Len(a)) \in 1..Len(b) /\ (x - Len(a)) < (y - Len(a))

  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <1>1

LEMMA AgAppendOK ==
  ASSUME NEW a \in Seq(fps), NEW e \in fps, AgSIncr(a), \A i \in 1..Len(a) : a[i] < e
  PROVE  /\ Append(a, e) \in Seq(fps)
         /\ AgSIncr(Append(a, e))
<1>1. Len(a) \in Nat
  BY AgST!LenProperties
<1>2. /\ Append(a, e) \in Seq(fps)
      /\ Len(Append(a, e)) = Len(a) + 1
      /\ \A i \in 1..Len(a) : Append(a, e)[i] = a[i]
      /\ Append(a, e)[Len(a)+1] = e
  BY AgST!AppendProperties
<1>3. AgSIncr(Append(a, e))
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW x \in 1..Len(Append(a, e)), NEW y \in 1..Len(Append(a, e)), x < y
                 PROVE  Append(a, e)[x] < Append(a, e)[y]
    BY DEF AgSIncr
  <2>2. x \in 1..Len(a)
    BY <2>1, <1>2, <1>1
  <2>3. CASE y = Len(a)+1
    BY <2>2, <2>3, <1>2
  <2>4. CASE y \in 1..Len(a)
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>4, <1>2 DEF AgSIncr
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <2>3, <2>4, <1>2, <1>1
<1>. QED  BY <1>2, <1>3

(***************************************************************************)
(* The inductive invariant.                                                *)
(***************************************************************************)
AgNegFps == { 0 - f : f \in fps }
AgVals == fps \cup AgNegFps \cup {empty}
AgEvL == {"strIns", "nestedIns", "set", "flush", "rtrn"}
AgAllL == AgEvL \cup {"pick", "put", "waitEv", "endWEv", "chkSnc", "cntns",
                      "onSnc", "insrt", "isMth", "cas", "tryEv", "waitIns",
                      "endEv", "Done"}
AgFrame == [procedure : {"Evict"}, pc : {"endEv"}, ei : Int, ej : Int,
            lo : AgVals \cup {0}]

AgInv ==
  /\ table \in [1..K -> AgVals]
  /\ external \in Seq(fps)
  /\ newexternal \in Seq(fps)
  /\ AgSIncr(external)
  /\ AgSIncr(newexternal)
  /\ evict \in BOOLEAN
  /\ waitCnt \in Int
  /\ history \in SUBSET fps
  /\ pc \in [Writer -> AgAllL]
  /\ stack \in [Writer -> Seq(AgFrame)]
  /\ ei \in [Writer -> Int]
  /\ ej \in [Writer -> Int]
  /\ lo \in [Writer -> AgVals \cup {0}]
  /\ fp \in [Writer -> fps \cup {0}]
  /\ index \in [Writer -> Int]
  /\ result \in [Writer -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ expected \in [Writer -> AgVals \cup Int]
  /\ \A s \in Writer : pc[s] \notin {"pick", "Done"} => fp[s] \in fps
  /\ \A s \in Writer : pc[s] \in {"nestedIns", "set"} => lo[s] \in AgVals
  /\ \A s \in Writer : pc[s] \in AgEvL => stack[s] # << >>
  /\ \A s \in Writer : pc[s] \in {"chkSnc", "cntns", "onSnc"} => expected[s] \in Int
  /\ \A s \in Writer : pc[s] = "Done" => history = fps

LEMMA AgInitInv == Init => AgInv
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME Init PROVE AgInv
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. << >> \in Seq(fps) /\ Len(<< >>) = 0 /\ << >> \in Seq(AgFrame)
  BY AgST!EmptySeq
<1>2. empty \in AgVals /\ 0 \in AgVals \cup {0}
  BY DEF AgVals
<1>. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, OAAssumption
  DEF Init, AgInv, AgSIncr, AgAllL, AgEvL, AgVals, ProcSet

LEMMA AgFlush == ASSUME AgInv, NEW self \in Writer, flush(self) PROVE AgInv'
<1> USE OAAssumption, AgModRange DEF AgInv, AgVals, AgNegFps, AgEvL, AgAllL
<1>pc. pc[self] = "flush" /\ fp[self] \in fps /\ stack[self] # << >>
  BY DEF flush
<1>ne. /\ newexternal \in Seq(fps)
       /\ AgSIncr(newexternal)
       /\ largestElem(newexternal) \in Nat
       /\ \A i \in 1..Len(newexternal) : newexternal[i] <= largestElem(newexternal)
  BY AgLargestElem
<1>ex. external \in Seq(fps) /\ AgSIncr(external)
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. CASE ei[self] <= K + L
  <2>d. /\ lo' = [lo EXCEPT ![self] = table[mod(ei[self], K)]]
        /\ ei' = [ei EXCEPT ![self] = ei[self] + 1]
        /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "flush"]
        /\ UNCHANGED << external, evict, waitCnt, history, stack, ej, fp,
                        index, result, expected >>
    BY <1>1 DEF flush
  <2>v. lo'[self] = table[mod(ei[self], K)] /\ lo'[self] \in AgVals
    BY <2>d
  <2>1. CASE ~(lo'[self] # empty /\
               lo'[self] > largestElem(newexternal) /\
               ((ei[self] <= K /\ ~wrapped(lo'[self], ei[self])) \/
                (ei[self] > K /\ wrapped(lo'[self], ei[self]))))
    <3>1. UNCHANGED << table, newexternal >>
      BY <1>1, <2>1 DEF flush
    <3>. QED  BY <1>pc, <2>d, <2>v, <3>1, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>2. CASE lo'[self] # empty /\
             lo'[self] > largestElem(newexternal) /\
             ((ei[self] <= K /\ ~wrapped(lo'[self], ei[self])) \/
              (ei[self] > K /\ wrapped(lo'[self], ei[self])))
    <3>1. /\ newexternal' = Append(newexternal \o
                              subSeqSmaller(external, newexternal, lo'[self]), lo'[self])
          /\ table' = [table EXCEPT ![mod(ei[self], K)] = lo'[self] * (-1)]
      BY <1>1, <2>2 DEF flush
    <3>2. lo'[self] \in fps
      BY <2>v, <2>2, <1>ne, AgT!SMTT("r30")
    <3>3. lo'[self] * (-1) \in AgNegFps
      BY <3>2, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF AgNegFps
    <3>4. table' \in [1..K -> AgVals]
      BY <3>1, <3>3 DEF AgVals, AgNegFps
    <3> DEFINE sel == SelectSeq(external,
                        LAMBDA pz : pz < lo'[self] /\ pz > largestElem(newexternal))
    <3>5. /\ sel \in Seq(fps)
          /\ AgSIncr(sel)
          /\ \A j \in 1..Len(sel) :
               \E k \in 1..Len(external) :
                  sel[j] = external[k] /\ external[k] < lo'[self]
                  /\ external[k] > largestElem(newexternal)
      BY AgSelSmaller, <1>ex
    <3>6. subSeqSmaller(external, newexternal, lo'[self]) = sel
      BY DEF subSeqSmaller
    <3>7. \A i \in 1..Len(newexternal) : \A j \in 1..Len(sel) : newexternal[i] < sel[j]
      <4>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(newexternal), NEW j \in 1..Len(sel)
                     PROVE  newexternal[i] < sel[j]
        OBVIOUS
      <4>2. PICK k \in 1..Len(external) :
               sel[j] = external[k] /\ external[k] > largestElem(newexternal)
        BY <3>5
      <4>3. newexternal[i] <= largestElem(newexternal)
        BY <1>ne
      <4>4. newexternal[i] \in Int /\ external[k] \in Int /\ largestElem(newexternal) \in Int
        BY <1>ne, <1>ex, AgST!ElementOfSeq, AgFpsInt
      <4>. QED  BY <4>2, <4>3, <4>4
    <3>8. /\ newexternal \o sel \in Seq(fps)
          /\ AgSIncr(newexternal \o sel)
          /\ Len(newexternal \o sel) = Len(newexternal) + Len(sel)
          /\ \A i \in 1..Len(newexternal \o sel) :
                (newexternal \o sel)[i] =
                   IF i <= Len(newexternal) THEN newexternal[i] ELSE sel[i - Len(newexternal)]
      BY <3>5, <3>7, <1>ne, AgConcatOK
    <3>9. \A i \in 1..Len(newexternal \o sel) : (newexternal \o sel)[i] < lo'[self]
      <4>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(newexternal \o sel)
                     PROVE  (newexternal \o sel)[i] < lo'[self]
        OBVIOUS
      <4>ln. Len(newexternal) \in Nat /\ Len(sel) \in Nat
        BY <1>ne, <3>5, AgST!LenProperties
      <4>2. CASE i <= Len(newexternal)
        <5>1. i \in 1..Len(newexternal)
          BY <4>1, <4>2, <3>8, <4>ln
        <5>2. newexternal[i] <= largestElem(newexternal)
          BY <5>1, <1>ne
        <5>3. newexternal[i] \in Int /\ lo'[self] \in Int
          BY <5>1, <1>ne, <3>2, AgST!ElementOfSeq, AgFpsInt
        <5>. QED  BY <5>2, <5>3, <4>2, <3>8, <2>2, <1>ne
      <4>3. CASE ~(i <= Len(newexternal))
        <5>1. (i - Len(newexternal)) \in 1..Len(sel)
          BY <4>1, <4>3, <3>8, <4>ln
        <5>2. PICK k \in 1..Len(external) :
                 sel[i - Len(newexternal)] = external[k] /\ external[k] < lo'[self]
          BY <5>1, <3>5
        <5>. QED  BY <5>1, <5>2, <4>3, <3>8
      <4>. QED  BY <4>2, <4>3
    <3>10. /\ newexternal' \in Seq(fps)
           /\ AgSIncr(newexternal')
      BY <3>1, <3>6, <3>8, <3>9, <3>2, AgAppendOK
    <3>. QED  BY <1>pc, <2>d, <2>v, <3>4, <3>10, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>2. CASE ~(ei[self] <= K + L)
  <2>d. /\ external' = newexternal \o subSeqLarger(external, newexternal)
        /\ newexternal' = << >>
        /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "rtrn"]
        /\ UNCHANGED << table, ei, lo, evict, waitCnt, history, stack, ej, fp,
                        index, result, expected >>
    BY <1>2 DEF flush
  <2>e. << >> \in Seq(fps) /\ Len(<< >>) = 0 /\ AgSIncr(<< >>)
    BY AgST!EmptySeq DEF AgSIncr
  <2>1. CASE newexternal = << >>
    <3>1. subSeqLarger(external, newexternal) = external
      BY <2>1 DEF subSeqLarger
    <3>2. external' = external
      BY <2>d, <3>1, <2>1, AgST!ConcatEmptySeq, <1>ex
    <3>. QED  BY <1>pc, <2>d, <2>e, <3>2, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>2. CASE newexternal # << >>
    <3> DEFINE sel == SelectSeq(external, LAMBDA pz : pz > largestElem(newexternal))
    <3>1. subSeqLarger(external, newexternal) = sel
      BY <2>2 DEF subSeqLarger
    <3>2. /\ sel \in Seq(fps)
          /\ AgSIncr(sel)
          /\ \A j \in 1..Len(sel) :
               \E k \in 1..Len(external) :
                  sel[j] = external[k] /\ external[k] > largestElem(newexternal)
      BY AgSelLarger, <1>ex
    <3>3. \A i \in 1..Len(newexternal) : \A j \in 1..Len(sel) : newexternal[i] < sel[j]
      <4>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(newexternal), NEW j \in 1..Len(sel)
                     PROVE  newexternal[i] < sel[j]
        OBVIOUS
      <4>2. PICK k \in 1..Len(external) :
               sel[j] = external[k] /\ external[k] > largestElem(newexternal)
        BY <3>2
      <4>3. newexternal[i] <= largestElem(newexternal)
        BY <1>ne
      <4>4. newexternal[i] \in Int /\ external[k] \in Int /\ largestElem(newexternal) \in Int
        BY <1>ne, <1>ex, AgST!ElementOfSeq, AgFpsInt
      <4>. QED  BY <4>2, <4>3, <4>4
    <3>4. /\ newexternal \o sel \in Seq(fps)
          /\ AgSIncr(newexternal \o sel)
      BY <3>2, <3>3, <1>ne, AgConcatOK
    <3>. QED  BY <1>pc, <2>d, <2>e, <3>1, <3>4, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2

         AgInsrt, AgIsMth, AgCas, AgTryEv, AgWaitIns, AgEndEv DEF p
  <2>tm. CASE Terminating
    BY <2>tm DEF AgInv, Terminating, vars
  <2>. QED  BY <2>ev, <2>pp, <2>tm, <1>2 DEF Next
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgSpecInv == Spec => []AgInv
<1>1. Init => AgInv
  BY AgInitInv
<1>2. AgInv /\ [Next]_vars => AgInv'
  BY AgNextInv
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, AgT!PTL DEF Spec

(***************************************************************************)
(* The probe function has exactly two regimes.  Writing r for the spread   *)
(* max(fps) - min(fps) and d for (K-1) \div r, the scale factor d either   *)
(* vanishes -- and then idx(f,p) does not depend on f at all -- or it is   *)
(* positive, and then distinct fingerprints get distinct home slots.       *)
(***************************************************************************)
AgR == max(fps) - min(fps)
AgD == (K - 1) \div AgR

LEMMA AgDFacts == /\ AgR \in Nat \ {0}
                  /\ AgD \in Nat
                  /\ AgD * AgR <= K - 1
<1>1. AgR \in Nat \ {0}
  BY AgMaxMin DEF AgR
<1>2. K - 1 \in Nat
  BY OAAssumption
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF AgD

LEMMA AgIdxExp == \A f, pz \in Int : idx(f, pz) = mod(AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + pz, K)
  BY DEF idx, rescale, AgD, AgR

(***************************************************************************)
(* The SMT backend computes x % K whenever x is confined to one period.    *)
(* Everything this module needs about mod is derived from that.            *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA AgModLo == \A x \in Int : 0 <= x /\ x < K => x % K = x
  BY OAAssumption, AgT!SMTT("r30")

LEMMA AgModHi == \A x \in Int : K <= x /\ x < 2 * K => x % K = x - K
  BY OAAssumption, AgT!SMTT("r30")

LEMMA AgModHi2 == \A x \in Int : 2 * K <= x /\ x < 3 * K => x % K = x - 2 * K
  BY OAAssumption, AgT!SMTT("r30")

LEMMA AgModVal ==
  \A x \in Int : 0 <= x /\ x < 3 * K =>
     mod(x, K) = IF x = 0 \/ x = K \/ x = 2 * K THEN K
                 ELSE IF x < K THEN x ELSE IF x < 2 * K THEN x - K ELSE x - 2 * K
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW x \in Int, 0 <= x, x < 3 * K
             PROVE  mod(x, K) = IF x = 0 \/ x = K \/ x = 2 * K THEN K
                                ELSE IF x < K THEN x
                                     ELSE IF x < 2 * K THEN x - K ELSE x - 2 * K
  OBVIOUS
<1>k. K \in Nat \ {0}
  BY OAAssumption
<1>1. CASE x < K
  <2>1. x % K = x
    BY <1>1, AgModLo
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <1>1, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF mod
<1>2. CASE K <= x /\ x < 2 * K
  <2>1. x % K = x - K
    BY <1>2, AgModHi
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <1>2, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF mod
<1>3. CASE 2 * K <= x
  <2>1. x % K = x - 2 * K
    BY <1>3, AgModHi2
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <1>3, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF mod
<1>4. x < K \/ (K <= x /\ x < 2 * K) \/ 2 * K <= x
  BY <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4

LEMMA AgModId == \A l \in Int : 1 <= l /\ l <= K - 1 => mod(l, K) = l
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW l \in Int, 1 <= l, l <= K - 1 PROVE mod(l, K) = l
  OBVIOUS
<1>k. K \in Nat \ {0}
  BY OAAssumption
<1>1. 0 <= l /\ l < 3 * K /\ l # 0 /\ l # K /\ l # 2 * K /\ l < K
  BY <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, AgModVal

LEMMA AgModZero == mod(0, K) = K /\ mod(K, K) = K
<1>k. K \in Nat \ {0} /\ K \in Int /\ 0 <= K /\ K < 3 * K /\ K # 2 * K
  BY OAAssumption, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>. QED  BY <1>k, AgModVal

LEMMA AgModInj ==
  ASSUME NEW x \in Int, NEW y \in Int, 0 <= x, x < 3 * K, 0 <= y, y < 3 * K,
         x < y, y - x < K
  PROVE  mod(x, K) # mod(y, K)
<1>k. K \in Nat \ {0}
  BY OAAssumption
<1>1. mod(x, K) = IF x = 0 \/ x = K \/ x = 2 * K THEN K
                  ELSE IF x < K THEN x ELSE IF x < 2 * K THEN x - K ELSE x - 2 * K
  BY AgModVal
<1>2. mod(y, K) = IF y = 0 \/ y = K \/ y = 2 * K THEN K
                  ELSE IF y < K THEN y ELSE IF y < 2 * K THEN y - K ELSE y - 2 * K
  BY AgModVal
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")

LEMMA AgIdxD0 == AgD = 0 => \A f, pz \in Int : idx(f, pz) = mod(pz, K)
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME AgD = 0, NEW f \in Int, NEW pz \in Int
             PROVE  idx(f, pz) = mod(pz, K)
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. min(fps) \in Nat
  BY AgMaxMin
<1>2. AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + pz = pz
  BY <1>1, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>. QED  BY <1>2, AgIdxExp

LEMMA AgMulMono ==
  ASSUME NEW u \in Nat, NEW v \in Int, NEW w \in Int, u # 0, 0 < v, v <= w
  PROVE  0 < u * v /\ u * v <= u * w
  BY AgT!SMTT("r30")

LEMMA AgIdxInj ==
  ASSUME AgD # 0, NEW f \in fps, NEW g \in fps, idx(f, 0) = idx(g, 0)
  PROVE  f = g
<1>1. AgR \in Nat \ {0} /\ AgD \in Nat /\ AgD * AgR <= K - 1
  BY AgDFacts
<1>2. min(fps) \in Nat /\ max(fps) \in Nat
      /\ \A y \in fps : min(fps) <= y /\ y <= max(fps)
  BY AgMaxMin
<1>3. \A y \in fps : y \in Int
  BY OAAssumption
<1>k. K \in Nat \ {0} /\ AgD \in Int /\ AgR \in Int /\ min(fps) \in Int
  BY <1>1, <1>2, OAAssumption
<1>d. AgD <= K - 1
  <2>1. AgD * 1 <= AgD * AgR
    BY <1>1, <1>k, AgMulMono
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <1>1, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>4. \A y \in fps : idx(y, 0) = mod(AgD * (y - min(fps) + 1) + 0, K)
  BY <1>3, AgIdxExp
<1>5. \A y \in fps : /\ AgD * (y - min(fps) + 1) + 0 \in Int
                     /\ 0 <= AgD * (y - min(fps) + 1) + 0
                     /\ AgD * (y - min(fps) + 1) + 0 < 3 * K
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW y \in fps
                 PROVE  /\ AgD * (y - min(fps) + 1) + 0 \in Int
                        /\ 0 <= AgD * (y - min(fps) + 1) + 0
                        /\ AgD * (y - min(fps) + 1) + 0 < 3 * K
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. y \in Int /\ 0 < y - min(fps) + 1 /\ y - min(fps) + 1 <= AgR + 1
    BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF AgR
  <2>3. 0 < AgD * (y - min(fps) + 1) /\ AgD * (y - min(fps) + 1) <= AgD * (AgR + 1)
    BY <2>2, <1>1, <1>k, AgMulMono
  <2>4. AgD * (AgR + 1) = AgD * AgR + AgD
    BY <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>. QED  BY <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <1>1, <1>d, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>6. \A a, b \in fps :
         a < b => mod(AgD * (a - min(fps) + 1) + 0, K) # mod(AgD * (b - min(fps) + 1) + 0, K)
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW a \in fps, NEW b \in fps, a < b
                 PROVE  mod(AgD * (a - min(fps) + 1) + 0, K)
                          # mod(AgD * (b - min(fps) + 1) + 0, K)
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. a \in Int /\ b \in Int /\ 0 < b - a /\ b - a <= AgR
    BY <2>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF AgR
  <2>3. 0 < AgD * (b - a) /\ AgD * (b - a) <= AgD * AgR
    BY <2>2, <1>1, <1>k, AgMulMono
  <2>4. (AgD * (b - min(fps) + 1) + 0) - (AgD * (a - min(fps) + 1) + 0) = AgD * (b - a)
    BY <2>2, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>5. /\ AgD * (a - min(fps) + 1) + 0 \in Int
        /\ 0 <= AgD * (a - min(fps) + 1) + 0
        /\ AgD * (a - min(fps) + 1) + 0 < 3 * K
        /\ AgD * (b - min(fps) + 1) + 0 \in Int
        /\ 0 <= AgD * (b - min(fps) + 1) + 0
        /\ AgD * (b - min(fps) + 1) + 0 < 3 * K
    BY <2>1, <1>5
  <2>6. AgD * (a - min(fps) + 1) + 0 < AgD * (b - min(fps) + 1) + 0
        /\ (AgD * (b - min(fps) + 1) + 0) - (AgD * (a - min(fps) + 1) + 0) < K
    BY <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <1>1, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>. QED  BY <2>5, <2>6, AgModInj
<1>7. SUFFICES ASSUME f # g PROVE FALSE
  OBVIOUS
<1>8. CASE f < g
  BY <1>8, <1>4, <1>6
<1>9. CASE g < f
  BY <1>9, <1>4, <1>6
<1>. QED  BY <1>3, <1>7, <1>8, <1>9

LEMMA AgBaseRange ==
  \A f \in fps : /\ AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) \in Int
                /\ 0 <= AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1)
                /\ AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) <= 2 * K - 2
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW f \in fps
             PROVE  /\ AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) \in Int
                    /\ 0 <= AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1)
                    /\ AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) <= 2 * K - 2
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. AgR \in Nat \ {0} /\ AgD \in Nat /\ AgD * AgR <= K - 1
  BY AgDFacts
<1>2. min(fps) \in Nat /\ max(fps) \in Nat
      /\ \A y \in fps : min(fps) <= y /\ y <= max(fps)
  BY AgMaxMin
<1>k. K \in Nat \ {0} /\ AgD \in Int /\ AgR \in Int /\ min(fps) \in Int /\ f \in Int
  BY <1>1, <1>2, OAAssumption
<1>3. CASE AgD = 0
  <2>1. AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) = 0
    BY <1>3, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>2. 0 \in Int /\ 0 <= 0 /\ 0 <= 2 * K - 2
    BY <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>4. CASE AgD # 0
  <2>d. AgD <= K - 1
    <3>1. AgD * 1 <= AgD * AgR
      BY <1>1, <1>k, <1>4, AgMulMono
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1, <1>1, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>2. 0 < f - min(fps) + 1 /\ f - min(fps) + 1 <= AgR + 1
    BY <1>2, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF AgR
  <2>3. 0 < AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) /\ AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) <= AgD * (AgR + 1)
    BY <2>2, <1>1, <1>k, <1>4, AgMulMono
  <2>4. AgD * (AgR + 1) = AgD * AgR + AgD
    BY <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>. QED  BY <2>3, <2>4, <2>d, <1>1, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>. QED  BY <1>3, <1>4

LEMMA AgIdxProbeInj ==
  ASSUME NEW f \in fps, NEW i \in 0..L, NEW j \in 0..L, idx(f, i) = idx(f, j)
  PROVE  i = j
<1>k. K \in Nat \ {0} /\ L \in Nat /\ 2 * L <= K /\ f \in Int
  BY OAAssumption
<1>b. /\ AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) \in Int
      /\ 0 <= AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1)
      /\ AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) <= 2 * K - 2
  BY AgBaseRange
<1>e. \A m \in 0..L : idx(f, m) = mod(AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + m, K)
  BY <1>k, AgIdxExp
<1>r. \A m \in 0..L : /\ AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + m \in Int
                      /\ 0 <= AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + m
                      /\ AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + m < 3 * K
  BY <1>b, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>1. SUFFICES ASSUME i # j PROVE FALSE
  OBVIOUS
<1>2. \A a, b \in 0..L :
         a < b => mod(AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + a, K) # mod(AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + b, K)
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW a \in 0..L, NEW b \in 0..L, a < b
                 PROVE  mod(AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + a, K)
                          # mod(AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + b, K)
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. /\ AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + a \in Int
        /\ 0 <= AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + a
        /\ AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + a < 3 * K
        /\ AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + b \in Int
        /\ 0 <= AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + b
        /\ AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + b < 3 * K
    BY <2>1, <1>r
  <2>3. AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + a < AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + b
        /\ (AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + b) - (AgD * (f - min(fps) + 1) + a) < K
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <1>b, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>. QED  BY <2>2, <2>3, AgModInj
<1>3. CASE i < j
  BY <1>3, <1>2, <1>e
<1>4. CASE j < i
  BY <1>4, <1>2, <1>e
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>3, <1>4, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")

(***************************************************************************)
(* CASE L = 0.  The probe window is empty, so insrt always falls through   *)
(* to tryEv and no cas ever fires: the table stays empty, history stays    *)
(* empty and the logs stay empty, whatever the eviction machinery does.    *)
(***************************************************************************)
AgFrameL0 == [procedure : {"Evict"}, pc : {"endEv"}, ei : Int, ej : Int, lo : {0, empty}]

AgInvL0 ==
  /\ \A s \in 1..K : table[s] = empty
  /\ history = {}
  /\ external = << >>
  /\ newexternal = << >>
  /\ \A w \in Writer : index[w] = 0
  /\ \A w \in Writer : pc[w] \notin {"cntns", "onSnc", "isMth", "cas"}
  /\ \A w \in Writer : lo[w] = 0 \/ lo[w] = empty
  /\ \A w \in Writer : pc[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"} => lo[w] = empty
  /\ \A w \in Writer : stack[w] \in Seq(AgFrameL0)

LEMMA AgInitL0 == ASSUME L = 0 PROVE Init => AgInvL0
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME Init PROVE AgInvL0
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. << >> \in Seq(AgFrameL0)
  BY AgST!EmptySeq
<1>. QED  BY <1>1 DEF Init, AgInvL0, ProcSet

LEMMA AgL0Quiet ==
  ASSUME L = 0, AgInv, AgInvL0, NEW self \in Writer,
         pc[self] \in {"cntns", "onSnc", "isMth", "cas"}
  PROVE  FALSE
  BY DEF AgInvL0

LEMMA AgL0Tbl ==
  ASSUME AgInv, AgInvL0, NEW s \in 1..K, NEW v, v = empty
  PROVE  \A t \in 1..K : [table EXCEPT ![s] = v][t] = empty
  BY DEF AgInv, AgInvL0

LEMMA AgNextL0 == ASSUME L = 0, AgInv, AgInvL0, [Next]_vars PROVE AgInvL0'
<1> USE OAAssumption DEF AgInvL0
<1>ty. table \in [1..K -> AgVals] /\ stack \in [Writer -> Seq(AgFrame)]
       /\ lo \in [Writer -> AgVals \cup {0}] /\ ei \in [Writer -> Int]
       /\ ej \in [Writer -> Int] /\ pc \in [Writer -> AgAllL]
       /\ index \in [Writer -> Int]
  BY DEF AgInv
<1>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
  BY <1>1 DEF vars
<1>2. CASE Next
  <2>a. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW self \in Writer,
                        \/ strIns(self) \/ nestedIns(self) \/ set(self)
                        \/ flush(self) \/ rtrn(self)
                        \/ pick(self) \/ put(self) \/ waitEv(self) \/ endWEv(self)
                        \/ chkSnc(self) \/ cntns(self) \/ onSnc(self) \/ insrt(self)
                        \/ isMth(self) \/ cas(self) \/ tryEv(self) \/ waitIns(self)
                        \/ endEv(self)
                 PROVE  AgInvL0'
    <3>1. CASE \E s \in ProcSet : Evict(s)
      BY <3>1 DEF ProcSet, Evict
    <3>2. CASE \E s \in Writer : p(s)
      BY <3>2 DEF p
    <3>3. CASE Terminating
      BY <3>3 DEF Terminating, vars
    <3>. QED  BY <1>2, <3>1, <3>2, <3>3 DEF Next
  <2>x. CASE cntns(self) \/ onSnc(self) \/ isMth(self) \/ cas(self)
    BY <2>x DEF cntns, onSnc, isMth, cas
  <2>b. CASE pick(self)
    BY <2>b, <1>ty, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF pick
  <2>c. CASE put(self)
    BY <2>c, <1>ty, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF put
  <2>d. CASE waitEv(self)
    BY <2>d, <1>ty, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF waitEv
  <2>e. CASE endWEv(self)
    BY <2>e, <1>ty, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF endWEv
  <2>f. CASE chkSnc(self)
    <3>1. external = << >> /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "insrt"]
      BY <2>f DEF chkSnc
    <3>2. UNCHANGED << table, external, newexternal, history, stack, lo, index >>
      BY <2>f DEF chkSnc
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1, <3>2, <1>ty, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>g. CASE insrt(self)
    <3>1. index[self] = 0 /\ ~(index[self] < L)
      OBVIOUS
    <3>2. pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "tryEv"]
      BY <2>g, <3>1 DEF insrt
    <3>3. UNCHANGED << table, external, newexternal, history, stack, lo, index >>
      BY <2>g DEF insrt
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <1>ty, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>h. CASE tryEv(self)
    BY <2>h, <1>ty, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF tryEv
  <2>i. CASE endEv(self)
    BY <2>i, <1>ty, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF endEv
  <2>j. CASE waitIns(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "waitIns" /\ (lo[self] = 0 \/ lo[self] = empty)
      BY <2>j DEF waitIns
    <3> DEFINE fr == [procedure |-> "Evict", pc |-> "endEv", ei |-> ei[self],
                      ej |-> ej[self], lo |-> lo[self]]
    <3>2. fr \in AgFrameL0
      BY <1>ty, <3>1 DEF AgFrameL0
    <3>3. << fr >> \in Seq(AgFrameL0)
      BY <3>2, AgST!AppendProperties, AgST!EmptySeq
    <3>4. << fr >> \o stack[self] \in Seq(AgFrameL0)
      BY <3>3, AgST!ConcatProperties
    <3>5. /\ stack' = [stack EXCEPT ![self] = << fr >> \o stack[self]]
          /\ lo' = [lo EXCEPT ![self] = 0]
          /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "strIns"]
          /\ UNCHANGED << table, external, newexternal, history, index >>
      BY <2>j DEF waitIns
    <3>. QED  BY <3>4, <3>5, <1>ty, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>k. CASE rtrn(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "rtrn" /\ stack[self] \in Seq(AgFrameL0) /\ stack[self] # << >>
      BY <2>k, AgST!EmptySeq DEF rtrn, AgInv, AgEvL
    <3>2. Head(stack[self]) \in AgFrameL0 /\ Tail(stack[self]) \in Seq(AgFrameL0)
      BY <3>1, AgST!HeadTailProperties
    <3>3. Head(stack[self]).pc = "endEv"
          /\ (Head(stack[self]).lo = 0 \/ Head(stack[self]).lo = empty)
      BY <3>2 DEF AgFrameL0
    <3>4. /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = Head(stack[self]).pc]
          /\ lo' = [lo EXCEPT ![self] = Head(stack[self]).lo]
          /\ stack' = [stack EXCEPT ![self] = Tail(stack[self])]
          /\ UNCHANGED << table, external, newexternal, history, index >>
      BY <2>k DEF rtrn
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, <1>ty, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>l. CASE strIns(self)
    <3>1. mod(ei[self] + 1, K) \in 1..K
      BY <1>ty, AgModRange
    <3>2. table[mod(ei[self] + 1, K)] = empty
      BY <3>1
    <3>3. CASE ei[self] <= K + L
      <4>1. /\ lo' = [lo EXCEPT ![self] = table[mod(ei[self] + 1, K)]]
            /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "nestedIns"]
            /\ UNCHANGED << table, external, newexternal, history, stack, index >>
        BY <2>l, <3>3 DEF strIns
      <4>. QED  BY <3>2, <4>1, <1>ty, AgT!SMTT("r30")
    <3>4. CASE ~(ei[self] <= K + L)
      <4>1. /\ lo' = lo
            /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "flush"]
            /\ UNCHANGED << table, external, newexternal, history, stack, index >>
        BY <2>l, <3>4 DEF strIns
      <4>. QED  BY <4>1, <1>ty, AgT!SMTT("r30")
    <3>. QED  BY <3>3, <3>4
  <2>m. CASE nestedIns(self)
    <3>1. mod(ej[self], K) \in 1..K /\ mod(ej[self] + 1, K) \in 1..K
      BY <1>ty, AgModRange
    <3>2. table[mod(ej[self], K)] = empty
      BY <3>1
    <3>3. /\ (table' = [table EXCEPT ![mod(ej[self] + 1, K)] = table[mod(ej[self], K)]]
               \/ table' = table)
          /\ (pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "set"] \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "nestedIns"])

    <3>. QED  BY <3>1, <3>4, <2>2, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>. QED  BY <2>4, <2>5, <1>ce
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3

(***************************************************************************)
(* Eviction is mutually exclusive.  waitCnt counts exactly the writers     *)
(* parked in waitEv/endWEv, and waitIns can only fire once every other     *)
(* writer is parked there, so while one writer runs the insertion sort and *)
(* the flush no other writer can touch table, history or the logs.         *)
(***************************************************************************)
AgEvPCs == {"waitIns", "strIns", "nestedIns", "set", "flush", "rtrn", "endEv"}
AgWaitPCs == {"waitEv", "endWEv"}
AgOutPCs == {"put", "waitEv", "endWEv"}
AgWaitSet == { w \in Writer : pc[w] \in AgWaitPCs }

AgInvEv ==
  /\ \A w \in Writer : pc[w] \in AgEvPCs => evict = TRUE
  /\ \A w1, w2 \in Writer : pc[w1] \in AgEvPCs /\ pc[w2] \in AgEvPCs => w1 = w2
  /\ waitCnt = Cardinality(AgWaitSet)
  /\ \A w \in Writer : pc[w] \in AgEvPCs /\ pc[w] # "waitIns" =>
        \A v \in Writer : v # w => pc[v] \in AgOutPCs

LEMMA AgWriterFin == AgFST!IsFiniteSet(Writer) /\ Cardinality(Writer) \in Nat
<1>1. AgFST!IsFiniteSet(Writer)
  BY WriterFinite, AgFinBridge
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, AgFST!FS_CardinalityType, AgCardBridge

LEMMA AgWaitFin ==
  \A S \in SUBSET Writer : AgFST!IsFiniteSet(S) /\ Cardinality(S) \in Nat
<1>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Writer
               PROVE  AgFST!IsFiniteSet(S) /\ Cardinality(S) \in Nat
  OBVIOUS
<1>2. AgFST!IsFiniteSet(Writer)
  BY AgWriterFin
<1>3. AgFST!IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY <1>1, <1>2, AgFST!FS_Subset
<1>. QED  BY <1>3, AgFST!FS_CardinalityType, AgCardBridge

LEMMA AgWaitFull ==
  ASSUME NEW self \in Writer, pc[self] \notin AgWaitPCs,
         Cardinality(AgWaitSet) = Cardinality(Writer) - 1 + Cardinality(Reader)
  PROVE  \A v \in Writer : v # self => pc[v] \in AgWaitPCs
<1>1. AgWaitSet \in SUBSET (Writer \ {self})
  BY DEF AgWaitSet
<1>2. AgFST!IsFiniteSet(Writer) /\ Cardinality(Writer) \in Nat
  BY AgWriterFin
<1>3. AgFST!IsFiniteSet(Writer \ {self}) /\ Cardinality(Writer \ {self}) \in Nat
  BY AgWaitFin
<1>4. Cardinality(Writer \ {self}) = Cardinality(Writer) - 1
  <2>1. AgFST!Cardinality(Writer \ {self})
          = IF self \in Writer THEN AgFST!Cardinality(Writer) - 1
                               ELSE AgFST!Cardinality(Writer)
    BY <1>2, AgFST!FS_RemoveElement
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, AgCardBridge
<1>5. Cardinality(AgWaitSet) <= Cardinality(Writer \ {self})
  <2>1. AgFST!Cardinality(AgWaitSet) <= AgFST!Cardinality(Writer \ {self})
    BY <1>1, <1>3, AgFST!FS_Subset
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, AgCardBridge
<1>6. Cardinality(Reader) \in Nat
  <2>1. AgFST!IsFiniteSet(Reader)
    BY ReaderFinite, AgFinBridge
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, AgFST!FS_CardinalityType, AgCardBridge
<1>7. Cardinality(AgWaitSet) \in Nat
  BY <1>1, AgWaitFin
<1>8. Cardinality(AgWaitSet) = Cardinality(Writer \ {self})
  BY <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>2, <1>3, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>9. AgWaitSet = Writer \ {self}
  <2>1. AgFST!Cardinality(Writer \ {self}) = AgFST!Cardinality(AgWaitSet)
    BY <1>8, AgCardBridge
  <2>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>3, <2>1, AgFST!FS_Subset
<1>. QED  BY <1>9 DEF AgWaitSet

LEMMA AgWaitStep ==
  ASSUME NEW self \in Writer, NEW q, pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = q],
         pc \in [Writer -> AgAllL]
  PROVE  /\ (pc[self] \in AgWaitPCs) = (q \in AgWaitPCs)
            => { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet
         /\ (pc[self] \notin AgWaitPCs /\ q \in AgWaitPCs)
            => { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet \cup {self}
               /\ self \notin AgWaitSet
         /\ (pc[self] \in AgWaitPCs /\ q \notin AgWaitPCs)
            => { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet \ {self}
               /\ self \in AgWaitSet
<1>1. \A w \in Writer : pc'[w] = IF w = self THEN q ELSE pc[w]
  OBVIOUS
<1>. QED  BY <1>1 DEF AgWaitSet

LEMMA AgCardAdd ==
  ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Writer, NEW x, x \notin S
  PROVE  Cardinality(S \cup {x}) = Cardinality(S) + 1
<1>1. AgFST!IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY AgWaitFin
<1>2. AgFST!Cardinality(S \cup {x})
        = IF x \in S THEN AgFST!Cardinality(S) ELSE AgFST!Cardinality(S) + 1
  BY <1>1, AgFST!FS_AddElement
<1>. QED  BY <1>2, AgCardBridge

LEMMA AgCardDel ==
  ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Writer, NEW x, x \in S
  PROVE  Cardinality(S \ {x}) = Cardinality(S) - 1
<1>1. AgFST!IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY AgWaitFin
<1>2. AgFST!Cardinality(S \ {x})
        = IF x \in S THEN AgFST!Cardinality(S) - 1 ELSE AgFST!Cardinality(S)
  BY <1>1, AgFST!FS_RemoveElement
<1>. QED  BY <1>2, AgCardBridge

LEMMA AgInitEv == Init => AgInvEv
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME Init PROVE AgInvEv
  OBVIOUS
<1>pc. \A w \in Writer : pc[w] = "pick"
  BY DEF Init, ProcSet
<1>1. AgWaitSet = {}
  BY <1>pc DEF AgWaitSet, AgWaitPCs
<1>2. Cardinality({}) = 0
  BY AgFST!FS_EmptySet, AgCardBridge
<1>. QED  BY <1>pc, <1>1, <1>2 DEF Init, AgInvEv, AgEvPCs

(***************************************************************************)
(* One generic step of AgInvEv, phrased so that every action only has to   *)
(* say where its writer moves, how evict changes and how waitCnt changes.  *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA AgEvStep ==
  ASSUME AgInv, AgInvEv, NEW self \in Writer, NEW q,
         pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = q],
         waitCnt' = Cardinality({ w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs }),
         q \in AgEvPCs => evict' = TRUE,
         q \notin AgEvPCs /\ pc[self] \in AgEvPCs => evict' = FALSE,
         q \notin AgEvPCs /\ pc[self] \notin AgEvPCs => evict' = evict,
         q \in AgEvPCs /\ pc[self] \notin AgEvPCs => q = "waitIns" /\ evict = FALSE,
         q \in AgEvPCs /\ q # "waitIns" /\ pc[self] = "waitIns"
             => \A v \in Writer : v # self => pc[v] \in AgOutPCs,
         (\E u \in Writer : u # self /\ pc[u] \in AgEvPCs /\ pc[u] # "waitIns")
             => q \in AgOutPCs
  PROVE  AgInvEv'
<1> USE DEF AgInvEv
<1>ty. pc \in [Writer -> AgAllL]
  BY DEF AgInv
<1>pp. \A w \in Writer : pc'[w] = IF w = self THEN q ELSE pc[w]
  BY <1>ty
<1>1. \A w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgEvPCs => evict' = TRUE
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW w \in Writer, pc'[w] \in AgEvPCs PROVE evict' = TRUE
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. CASE w = self
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <1>pp
  <2>3. CASE w # self
    <3>1. pc[w] \in AgEvPCs /\ evict = TRUE
      BY <2>1, <2>3, <1>pp
    <3>2. CASE q \in AgEvPCs
      BY <3>2
    <3>3. CASE q \notin AgEvPCs /\ pc[self] \in AgEvPCs
      BY <3>1, <3>3, <2>3
    <3>4. CASE q \notin AgEvPCs /\ pc[self] \notin AgEvPCs
      BY <3>1, <3>4
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4
  <2>. QED  BY <2>2, <2>3
<1>2. \A w1, w2 \in Writer : pc'[w1] \in AgEvPCs /\ pc'[w2] \in AgEvPCs => w1 = w2
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW w1 \in Writer, NEW w2 \in Writer,
                        pc'[w1] \in AgEvPCs, pc'[w2] \in AgEvPCs, w1 # w2
                 PROVE  FALSE
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW u \in Writer, u # self, pc'[self] \in AgEvPCs,
                        pc'[u] \in AgEvPCs
                 PROVE  FALSE
    <3>1. CASE w1 # self /\ w2 # self
      BY <2>1, <3>1, <1>pp
    <3>2. CASE w1 = self
      BY <2>1, <3>2, <2>2
    <3>3. CASE w2 = self
      BY <2>1, <3>3, <2>2
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3
  <2>3. q \in AgEvPCs /\ pc[u] \in AgEvPCs
    BY <2>2, <1>pp
  <2>4. CASE pc[self] \in AgEvPCs
    BY <2>2, <2>3, <2>4
  <2>5. CASE pc[self] \notin AgEvPCs
    BY <2>2, <2>3, <2>5
  <2>. QED  BY <2>4, <2>5
<1>3. waitCnt' = Cardinality(AgWaitSet')
  BY DEF AgWaitSet
<1>4. \A w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgEvPCs /\ pc'[w] # "waitIns" =>
         \A v \in Writer : v # w => pc'[v] \in AgOutPCs
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW w \in Writer, pc'[w] \in AgEvPCs, pc'[w] # "waitIns",
                        NEW v \in Writer, v # w
                 PROVE  pc'[v] \in AgOutPCs
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. CASE w = self
    <3>1. q \in AgEvPCs /\ q # "waitIns" /\ pc'[v] = pc[v] /\ v # self
      BY <2>1, <2>2, <1>pp
    <3>2. CASE pc[self] \notin AgEvPCs
      BY <3>1, <3>2
    <3>3. CASE pc[self] \in AgEvPCs /\ pc[self] # "waitIns"
      BY <3>1, <3>3, <2>2
    <3>4. CASE pc[self] = "waitIns"
      BY <3>1, <3>4
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4
  <2>3. CASE w # self
    <3>1. pc[w] \in AgEvPCs /\ pc[w] # "waitIns"
      BY <2>1, <2>3, <1>pp
    <3>2. CASE v = self
      <4>1. q \in AgOutPCs
        BY <3>1, <2>3
      <4>. QED  BY <4>1, <3>2, <1>pp
    <3>3. CASE v # self
      BY <2>1, <3>1, <3>3, <1>pp
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3
  <2>. QED  BY <2>2, <2>3
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4

LEMMA AgNextEv == ASSUME AgInv, AgInvEv, [Next]_vars PROVE AgInvEv'
<1> USE DEF AgEvPCs, AgWaitPCs, AgOutPCs
<1>ty. pc \in [Writer -> AgAllL] /\ stack \in [Writer -> Seq(AgFrame)]
       /\ waitCnt \in Int
  BY DEF AgInv
<1>fin. Cardinality(AgWaitSet) \in Nat
  BY AgWaitFin DEF AgWaitSet
<1>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
  BY <1>1 DEF AgInvEv, AgWaitSet, vars
<1>2. CASE Next
  <2>a. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW self \in Writer,
                        \/ strIns(self) \/ nestedIns(self) \/ set(self)
                        \/ flush(self) \/ rtrn(self)
                        \/ pick(self) \/ put(self) \/ waitEv(self) \/ endWEv(self)
                        \/ chkSnc(self) \/ cntns(self) \/ onSnc(self) \/ insrt(self)
                        \/ isMth(self) \/ cas(self) \/ tryEv(self) \/ waitIns(self)
                        \/ endEv(self)
                 PROVE  AgInvEv'
    <3>1. CASE \E s \in ProcSet : Evict(s)
      BY <3>1 DEF ProcSet, Evict
    <3>2. CASE \E s \in Writer : p(s)
      BY <3>2 DEF p
    <3>3. CASE Terminating
      BY <3>3 DEF AgInvEv, AgWaitSet, Terminating, vars
    <3>. QED  BY <1>2, <3>1, <3>2, <3>3 DEF Next
  <2>st. \A qq : pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = qq] =>
            /\ (pc[self] \in AgWaitPCs) = (qq \in AgWaitPCs)
               => { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet
            /\ (pc[self] \notin AgWaitPCs /\ qq \in AgWaitPCs)
               => { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet \cup {self}
                  /\ self \notin AgWaitSet
            /\ (pc[self] \in AgWaitPCs /\ qq \notin AgWaitPCs)
               => { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet \ {self}
                  /\ self \in AgWaitSet
    BY <1>ty, AgWaitStep
  <2>sub. AgWaitSet \in SUBSET Writer /\ AgWaitSet \cup {self} \in SUBSET Writer
    BY DEF AgWaitSet
  (*  writers that stay outside the eviction region and outside waiting    *)
  <2>plain. ASSUME NEW qq,
                   pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = qq],
                   pc[self] \notin AgEvPCs, qq \notin AgEvPCs,
                   pc[self] \notin AgWaitPCs, qq \notin AgWaitPCs,
                   pc[self] \notin AgOutPCs,
                   UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
            PROVE  AgInvEv'
    <3>1. waitCnt' = Cardinality({ w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs })
      BY <2>plain, <2>st DEF AgInvEv
    <3>2. (\E u \in Writer : u # self /\ pc[u] \in AgEvPCs /\ pc[u] # "waitIns")
             => qq \in AgOutPCs
      BY <2>plain DEF AgInvEv
    <3>. QED  BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>2, AgEvStep
  <2>b. CASE pick(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "pick" /\ UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
      BY <2>b DEF pick
    <3>2. pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "Done"] \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "put"]
      BY <2>b DEF pick
    <3>3. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "Done"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>3
    <3>4. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "put"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>4
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4
  <2>c. CASE chkSnc(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "chkSnc" /\ UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
      BY <2>c DEF chkSnc
    <3>2. pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cntns"] \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "insrt"]
      BY <2>c DEF chkSnc
    <3>3. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cntns"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>3
    <3>4. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "insrt"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>4
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4
  <2>d. CASE cntns(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "cntns" /\ UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
      BY <2>d DEF cntns
    <3>2. \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "pick"]
          \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "onSnc"]
          \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cntns"]
      BY <2>d DEF cntns
    <3>3. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "pick"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>3
    <3>4. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "onSnc"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>4
    <3>5. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cntns"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>5
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, <3>5
  <2>e. CASE onSnc(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "onSnc" /\ UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
      BY <2>e DEF onSnc
    <3>2. pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "pick"] \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "insrt"]
      BY <2>e DEF onSnc
    <3>3. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "pick"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>3
    <3>4. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "insrt"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>4
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4
  <2>f. CASE insrt(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "insrt" /\ UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
      BY <2>f DEF insrt
    <3>2. \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cas"]
          \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "isMth"]
          \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "tryEv"]
      BY <2>f DEF insrt
    <3>3. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cas"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>3
    <3>4. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "isMth"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>4
    <3>5. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "tryEv"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>5
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, <3>5
  <2>g. CASE isMth(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "isMth" /\ UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
      BY <2>g DEF isMth
    <3>2. pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "pick"] \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "insrt"]
      BY <2>g DEF isMth
    <3>3. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "pick"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>3
    <3>4. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "insrt"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>4
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4
  <2>h. CASE cas(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "cas" /\ UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
      BY <2>h DEF cas
    <3>2. pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "pick"] \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "insrt"]
      BY <2>h DEF cas
    <3>3. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "pick"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>3
    <3>4. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "insrt"]
      BY <2>plain, <3>1, <3>4
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4
  <2>i. CASE put(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "put" /\ UNCHANGED evict
      BY <2>i DEF put
    <3>2. CASE evict
      <4>1. waitCnt' = waitCnt + 1 /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "waitEv"]
        BY <2>i, <3>2 DEF put
      <4>2. { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet \cup {self}
            /\ self \notin AgWaitSet
        BY <4>1, <3>1, <2>st
      <4>3. Cardinality(AgWaitSet \cup {self}) = Cardinality(AgWaitSet) + 1
        BY <4>2, <2>sub, AgCardAdd
      <4>4. waitCnt' = Cardinality({ w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs })
        BY <4>1, <4>2, <4>3 DEF AgInvEv
      <4>5. (\E u \in Writer : u # self /\ pc[u] \in AgEvPCs /\ pc[u] # "waitIns")
               => "waitEv" \in AgOutPCs
        OBVIOUS
      <4>. QED  BY <4>1, <4>4, <4>5, <3>1, AgEvStep
    <3>3. CASE ~evict
      <4>1. waitCnt' = waitCnt /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "chkSnc"]
        BY <2>i, <3>3 DEF put
      <4>2. { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet
        BY <4>1, <3>1, <2>st
      <4>3. waitCnt' = Cardinality({ w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs })
        BY <4>1, <4>2 DEF AgInvEv
      <4>4. (\E u \in Writer : u # self /\ pc[u] \in AgEvPCs /\ pc[u] # "waitIns")
               => "chkSnc" \in AgOutPCs
        BY <3>3, <3>1 DEF AgInvEv
      <4>. QED  BY <4>1, <4>3, <4>4, <3>1, AgEvStep
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3
  <2>j. CASE waitEv(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "waitEv" /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "endWEv"]
          /\ UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
      BY <2>j DEF waitEv
    <3>2. { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet
      BY <3>1, <2>st
    <3>3. waitCnt' = Cardinality({ w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs })
      BY <3>1, <3>2 DEF AgInvEv
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1, <3>3, AgEvStep
  <2>k. CASE endWEv(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "endWEv" /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "put"]

    <3>2. { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet \ {self}
          /\ self \in AgWaitSet
      BY <3>1, <2>st
    <3>3. Cardinality(AgWaitSet \ {self}) = Cardinality(AgWaitSet) - 1
      BY <3>2, <2>sub, AgCardDel
    <3>4. waitCnt' = Cardinality({ w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs })
      BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3 DEF AgInvEv
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1, <3>4, AgEvStep
  <2>l. CASE tryEv(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "tryEv" /\ UNCHANGED waitCnt
      BY <2>l DEF tryEv
    <3>2. CASE evict = FALSE
      <4>1. evict' = TRUE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "waitIns"]
        BY <2>l, <3>2 DEF tryEv
      <4>2. { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet
        BY <4>1, <3>1, <2>st
      <4>3. waitCnt' = Cardinality({ w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs })
        BY <3>1, <4>2 DEF AgInvEv
      <4>4. (\E u \in Writer : u # self /\ pc[u] \in AgEvPCs /\ pc[u] # "waitIns")
               => "waitIns" \in AgOutPCs
        BY <3>2 DEF AgInvEv
      <4>. QED  BY <4>1, <4>3, <4>4, <3>1, <3>2, AgEvStep
    <3>3. CASE evict # FALSE
      <4>1. evict' = evict /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "put"]
        BY <2>l, <3>3 DEF tryEv
      <4>2. { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet
        BY <4>1, <3>1, <2>st
      <4>3. waitCnt' = Cardinality({ w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs })
        BY <3>1, <4>2 DEF AgInvEv
      <4>. QED  BY <4>1, <4>3, <3>1, AgEvStep
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3
  <2>m. CASE waitIns(self)
    <3>1. /\ pc[self] = "waitIns"
          /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "strIns"]
          /\ waitCnt = Cardinality(Writer) - 1 + Cardinality(Reader)
          /\ UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
      BY <2>m DEF waitIns
    <3>2. { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet
      BY <3>1, <2>st
    <3>3. waitCnt' = Cardinality({ w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs })
      BY <3>1, <3>2 DEF AgInvEv
    <3>4. Cardinality(AgWaitSet) = Cardinality(Writer) - 1 + Cardinality(Reader)
      BY <3>1 DEF AgInvEv
    <3>5. \A v \in Writer : v # self => pc[v] \in AgWaitPCs
      BY <3>1, <3>4, AgWaitFull
    <3>6. evict' = TRUE
      BY <3>1 DEF AgInvEv
    <3>7. (\E u \in Writer : u # self /\ pc[u] \in AgEvPCs /\ pc[u] # "waitIns")
             => "strIns" \in AgOutPCs
      BY <3>1 DEF AgInvEv
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1, <3>3, <3>5, <3>6, <3>7, AgEvStep
  <2>ins. ASSUME NEW qq, pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = qq],
                 pc[self] \in AgEvPCs, pc[self] # "waitIns", qq \in AgEvPCs,
                 UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
          PROVE  AgInvEv'
    <3>1. { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet
      BY <2>ins, <2>st
    <3>2. waitCnt' = Cardinality({ w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs })
      BY <2>ins, <3>1 DEF AgInvEv
    <3>3. evict' = TRUE
      BY <2>ins DEF AgInvEv
    <3>4. (\E u \in Writer : u # self /\ pc[u] \in AgEvPCs /\ pc[u] # "waitIns")
             => qq \in AgOutPCs
      BY <2>ins DEF AgInvEv
    <3>. QED  BY <2>ins, <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, AgEvStep
  <2>n. CASE strIns(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "strIns" /\ UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
      BY <2>n DEF strIns
    <3>2. pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "nestedIns"] \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "flush"]
      BY <2>n DEF strIns
    <3>3. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "nestedIns"]
      BY <2>ins, <3>1, <3>3
    <3>4. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "flush"]
      BY <2>ins, <3>1, <3>4
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4
  <2>o. CASE nestedIns(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "nestedIns" /\ UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
      BY <2>o DEF nestedIns
    <3>2. pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "set"] \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "nestedIns"]
      BY <2>o DEF nestedIns
    <3>3. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "set"]
      BY <2>ins, <3>1, <3>3
    <3>4. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "nestedIns"]
      BY <2>ins, <3>1, <3>4
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4
  <2>p. CASE set(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "set" /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "strIns"]
          /\ UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
      BY <2>p DEF set
    <3>. QED  BY <2>ins, <3>1
  <2>q. CASE flush(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "flush" /\ UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
      BY <2>q DEF flush
    <3>2. pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "flush"] \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "rtrn"]
      BY <2>q DEF flush
    <3>3. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "flush"]
      BY <2>ins, <3>1, <3>3
    <3>4. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "rtrn"]
      BY <2>ins, <3>1, <3>4
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4
  <2>r. CASE rtrn(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "rtrn" /\ stack[self] # << >> /\ stack[self] \in Seq(AgFrame)
          /\ UNCHANGED << evict, waitCnt >>
      BY <2>r, <1>ty DEF rtrn, AgInv, AgEvL
    <3>2. Head(stack[self]) \in AgFrame
      BY <3>1, AgST!HeadTailProperties
    <3>3. Head(stack[self]).pc = "endEv"
      BY <3>2 DEF AgFrame
    <3>4. pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "endEv"]
      BY <2>r, <3>3 DEF rtrn
    <3>. QED  BY <2>ins, <3>1, <3>4
  <2>s. CASE endEv(self)
    <3>1. pc[self] = "endEv" /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "put"]
          /\ evict' = FALSE /\ UNCHANGED waitCnt
      BY <2>s DEF endEv
    <3>2. { w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs } = AgWaitSet
      BY <3>1, <2>st
    <3>3. waitCnt' = Cardinality({ w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in AgWaitPCs })
      BY <3>1, <3>2 DEF AgInvEv
    <3>4. (\E u \in Writer : u # self /\ pc[u] \in AgEvPCs /\ pc[u] # "waitIns")
             => "put" \in AgOutPCs
      OBVIOUS
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1, <3>3, <3>4, AgEvStep
  <2>. QED  BY <2>a, <2>b, <2>c, <2>d, <2>e, <2>f, <2>g, <2>h, <2>i, <2>j,
               <2>k, <2>l, <2>m, <2>n, <2>o, <2>p, <2>q, <2>r, <2>s
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgSpecEv == Spec => [](AgInv /\ AgInvEv)
<1>1. Init => AgInv /\ AgInvEv
  BY AgInitInv, AgInitEv
<1>2. (AgInv /\ AgInvEv) /\ [Next]_vars => (AgInv /\ AgInvEv)'

(***************************************************************************)
(* CASE L # 0 and AgD = 0.  Every fingerprint then has the same probe      *)
(* sequence idx(f,l) = mod(l,K), so only the L cells AgCl(0) .. AgCl(L-1)  *)
(* are ever occupied and the insertion sort can only shuffle values        *)
(* between them.                                                           *)
(***************************************************************************)
AgCl(l) == mod(l, K)
AgCells == { AgCl(l) : l \in 0..(L-1) }
AgNoDup(t) == \A i, j \in 1..K :
                 i # j /\ t[i] # empty /\ t[j] # empty => abs(t[i]) # abs(t[j])
AgInsPCs == {"insrt", "isMth", "cas"}
AgScanPCs == {"cntns", "onSnc"}

LEMMA AgClRange == \A l \in Int : AgCl(l) \in 1..K
  BY AgModRange DEF AgCl

LEMMA AgLK == ASSUME L # 0 PROVE L \in Nat \ {0} /\ K \in Nat \ {0} /\ L < K /\ 2 * L <= K
<1>1. L \in Nat /\ K \in Nat \ {0} /\ 2 * L <= K
  BY OAAssumption
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, AgT!SMTT("r30")

LEMMA AgClInj ==
  ASSUME L # 0, NEW l \in 0..(L-1), NEW m \in 0..(L-1), AgCl(l) = AgCl(m)
  PROVE  l = m
<1>k. L \in Nat \ {0} /\ K \in Nat \ {0} /\ L < K
  BY AgLK
<1>1. SUFFICES ASSUME l < m PROVE FALSE
  <2>1. l \in Int /\ m \in Int
    BY <1>k
  <2>2. CASE m < l
    <3>1. AgCl(m) # AgCl(l)
      BY <2>2, <1>k, AgModInj DEF AgCl
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1
  <2>. QED  BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>2. l \in Int /\ m \in Int /\ 0 <= l /\ l < 3 * K /\ 0 <= m /\ m < 3 * K
      /\ m - l < K
  BY <1>1, <1>k, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, AgModInj DEF AgCl

LEMMA AgCellIn == \A l \in 0..(L-1) : AgCl(l) \in AgCells
  BY DEF AgCells

LEMMA AgIdxCl == ASSUME AgD = 0, NEW f \in Int, NEW l \in Int PROVE idx(f, l) = AgCl(l)
  BY AgIdxD0 DEF AgCl

AgWnLoc(t, pcv, idxv, expv, fpv) ==
  /\ idxv \in 0..L
  /\ pcv \in {"isMth", "cas"} => idxv \in 0..(L-1)
  /\ pcv \in AgScanPCs \cup {"chkSnc"} => expv \in 0..L
  /\ pcv = "chkSnc" => idxv = 0
  /\ pcv = "onSnc" => expv <= idxv
  /\ pcv = "cas" => (expv = empty \/ (expv \in AgNegFps /\ expv # -1 * fpv))
  /\ pcv \in AgInsPCs =>
        \A l \in 0..(idxv - 1) : t[AgCl(l)] \in fps /\ t[AgCl(l)] # fpv
  /\ pcv \in AgScanPCs =>
        \A l \in 0..(minimum(expv, idxv) - 1) : t[AgCl(l)] \in fps /\ t[AgCl(l)] # fpv
  /\ pcv \in AgInsPCs \cup {"onSnc"} =>
        \A l \in 0..(L-1) : (t[AgCl(l)] = fpv \/ t[AgCl(l)] = -1 * fpv) =>
           \A m \in 0..(l-1) : t[AgCl(m)] \in fps
  /\ pcv = "cntns" =>
        \A l \in 0..(idxv - 1) : (t[AgCl(l)] = fpv \/ t[AgCl(l)] = -1 * fpv) =>
           \A m \in 0..(l-1) : t[AgCl(m)] \in fps
  /\ pcv = "isMth" => (t[AgCl(idxv)] \in fps \/ t[AgCl(idxv)] = -1 * fpv)

AgWnTbl(t) ==
  /\ \A s \in 1..K : s \notin AgCells => t[s] = empty
  /\ \A l \in 0..(L-1) : t[AgCl(l)] # empty => \A m \in 0..(l-1) : t[AgCl(m)] # empty

AgInvWn ==
  /\ AgWnTbl(table)
  /\ \A w \in Writer : AgWnLoc(table, pc[w], index[w], expected[w], fp[w])
  /\ \A w \in Writer : pc[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"} =>
        /\ (lo[w] # empty => AgCl(ej[w] + 1) \in AgCells)
        /\ ((lo[w] = empty) <=> (table[AgCl(ej[w] + 1)] = empty))
        /\ AgNoDup([table EXCEPT ![AgCl(ej[w] + 1)] = lo[w]])
  /\ \A w \in Writer : pc[w] = "strIns" => ej[w] = ei[w]
  /\ ((\A w \in Writer : pc[w] \notin {"nestedIns", "set"}) => AgNoDup(table))
  /\ (external = << >> /\ newexternal = << >> =>
        \A l \in 0..(L-1) : table[AgCl(l)] \notin AgNegFps)
  /\ (external = << >> /\ newexternal = << >> =>
        \A w \in Writer : pc[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"} => lo[w] \notin AgNegFps)
  /\ (newexternal # << >> => \E w \in Writer : pc[w] = "flush")

LEMMA AgInitWn == ASSUME L # 0, AgD = 0 PROVE Init => AgInvWn
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME Init PROVE AgInvWn
  OBVIOUS
<1>t. \A s \in 1..K : table[s] = empty
  BY DEF Init
<1>c. \A l \in Int : table[AgCl(l)] = empty
  BY <1>t, AgClRange
<1>pc. \A w \in Writer : pc[w] = "pick"
  BY DEF Init, ProcSet
<1>1. AgNoDup(table)
  BY <1>t DEF AgNoDup
<1>2. \A l \in 0..(L-1) : table[AgCl(l)] \notin AgNegFps
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW l \in 0..(L-1), empty \in AgNegFps PROVE FALSE
    BY <1>c
  <2>2. PICK g \in fps : empty = 0 - g
    BY <2>1 DEF AgNegFps
  <2>3. 0 - g \in Int
    BY OAAssumption
  <2>. QED  BY <2>2, <2>3, EmptyNotInt
<1>3. \A w \in Writer : index[w] = 0 /\ 0 \in 0..L
  BY OAAssumption DEF Init, ProcSet
<1>4. \A w \in Writer : pc[w] \notin {"isMth", "cas"}
      /\ pc[w] \notin AgScanPCs \cup {"chkSnc"}
      /\ pc[w] \notin AgInsPCs \cup {"onSnc"}
      /\ pc[w] \notin {"nestedIns", "set"}
      /\ pc[w] # "cntns" /\ pc[w] # "strIns" /\ pc[w] # "cas"
      /\ pc[w] # "chkSnc" /\ pc[w] # "onSnc" /\ pc[w] # "flush"
  BY <1>pc DEF AgInsPCs, AgScanPCs
<1>5. newexternal = << >>
  BY DEF Init
<1>6. \A w \in Writer : AgWnLoc(table, pc[w], index[w], expected[w], fp[w])
  BY <1>3, <1>4 DEF AgWnLoc
<1>7. AgWnTbl(table)
  BY <1>t, <1>c DEF AgWnTbl
<1>8. \A w \in Writer : lo[w] = 0 /\ 0 \notin AgNegFps
  <2>1. \A w \in Writer : lo[w] = 0
    BY DEF Init, ProcSet
  <2>2. SUFFICES ASSUME 0 \in AgNegFps PROVE FALSE
    BY <2>1
  <2>3. PICK g \in fps : 0 = 0 - g
    BY <2>2 DEF AgNegFps
  <2>. QED  BY <2>3, OAAssumption, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8 DEF AgInvWn

(***************************************************************************)
(* Frame step: a writer that is outside the eviction region moves, nothing *)
(* else changes.  Only that writer's own local invariant has to be         *)
(* re-established.                                                         *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA AgWnFrame ==
  ASSUME L # 0, AgD = 0, AgInv, AgInvWn, NEW self \in Writer, NEW q,
         pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = q],
         pc[self] \notin {"nestedIns", "set", "strIns", "flush"},
         q \notin {"nestedIns", "set", "strIns", "flush"},
         AgWnLoc(table, q, index'[self], expected'[self], fp'[self]),
         \A w \in Writer : w # self =>
            /\ index'[w] = index[w] /\ expected'[w] = expected[w] /\ fp'[w] = fp[w]
            /\ lo'[w] = lo[w] /\ ei'[w] = ei[w] /\ ej'[w] = ej[w],
         UNCHANGED << table, external, newexternal >>
  PROVE  AgInvWn'
<1> USE DEF AgInvWn
<1>ty. pc \in [Writer -> AgAllL]
  BY DEF AgInv
<1>pp. \A w \in Writer : pc'[w] = IF w = self THEN q ELSE pc[w]
  BY <1>ty
<1>1. AgWnTbl(table')
  BY DEF AgWnTbl
<1>2. \A w \in Writer : AgWnLoc(table', pc'[w], index'[w], expected'[w], fp'[w])
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW w \in Writer
                 PROVE  AgWnLoc(table, pc'[w], index'[w], expected'[w], fp'[w])
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. CASE w = self
    BY <2>2, <1>pp
  <2>3. CASE w # self
    BY <2>3, <1>pp
  <2>. QED  BY <2>2, <2>3
<1>3. \A w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"} =>
         /\ (lo'[w] # empty => AgCl(ej'[w] + 1) \in AgCells)
         /\ ((lo'[w] = empty) <=> (table'[AgCl(ej'[w] + 1)] = empty))
         /\ AgNoDup([table' EXCEPT ![AgCl(ej'[w] + 1)] = lo'[w]])
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW w \in Writer, pc'[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"}
                 PROVE  /\ (lo[w] # empty => AgCl(ej[w] + 1) \in AgCells)
                        /\ ((lo[w] = empty) <=> (table[AgCl(ej[w] + 1)] = empty))
                        /\ AgNoDup([table EXCEPT ![AgCl(ej[w] + 1)] = lo[w]])
    <3>1. \A w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"} => w # self
      BY <1>pp
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1
  <2>2. w # self /\ pc[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"}
    BY <2>1, <1>pp
  <2>. QED  BY <2>2
<1>4. \A w \in Writer : pc'[w] = "strIns" => ej'[w] = ei'[w]
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW w \in Writer, pc'[w] = "strIns" PROVE ej[w] = ei[w]
    <3>1. \A w \in Writer : pc'[w] = "strIns" => w # self
      BY <1>pp
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1
  <2>2. w # self /\ pc[w] = "strIns"
    BY <2>1, <1>pp
  <2>. QED  BY <2>2
<1>5. (\A w \in Writer : pc'[w] \notin {"nestedIns", "set"}) => AgNoDup(table')
  BY <1>pp
<1>6. external' = << >> /\ newexternal' = << >> =>
         \A l \in 0..(L-1) : table'[AgCl(l)] \notin AgNegFps
  OBVIOUS
<1>6a. external' = << >> /\ newexternal' = << >> =>
          \A w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"} => lo'[w] \notin AgNegFps
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME external = << >>, newexternal = << >>,
                        NEW w \in Writer, pc'[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"}
                 PROVE  lo[w] \notin AgNegFps
    <3>1. \A w \in Writer : pc'[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"} => w # self
      BY <1>pp
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1
  <2>2. w # self /\ pc[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"}
    BY <2>1, <1>pp
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>7. newexternal' # << >> => \E w \in Writer : pc'[w] = "flush"
  BY <1>pp
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>6a, <1>7

(***************************************************************************)
(* Facts shared by all of the window-case action lemmas.                   *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA AgWnCommon ==
  ASSUME L # 0, AgD = 0, AgInv, NEW self \in Writer, pc[self] \notin {"pick", "Done"}
  PROVE  /\ table \in [1..K -> AgVals]
         /\ fp[self] \in fps
         /\ index[self] \in Int
         /\ \A l \in Int : AgCl(l) \in 1..K
         /\ \A l \in Int : idx(fp[self], l) = AgCl(l)
         /\ \A l \in Int : table[AgCl(l)] \in AgVals
         /\ empty # fp[self] /\ empty # -1 * fp[self]
         /\ \A v \in AgNegFps : v < 0
         /\ \A v \in fps : v > 0
<1>1. table \in [1..K -> AgVals] /\ index[self] \in Int /\ fp[self] \in fps
  BY DEF AgInv
<1>2. \A l \in Int : AgCl(l) \in 1..K
  BY AgClRange
<1>3. \A l \in Int : idx(fp[self], l) = AgCl(l)
  BY <1>1, OAAssumption, AgIdxCl
<1>4. \A l \in Int : table[AgCl(l)] \in AgVals
  BY <1>1, <1>2
<1>5. empty # fp[self] /\ empty # -1 * fp[self]
  <2>1. -1 * fp[self] \in Int
    BY <1>1, OAAssumption
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <1>1, OAAssumption, EmptyNotInt
<1>6. \A v \in AgNegFps : v < 0
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW v \in AgNegFps PROVE v < 0
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. PICK g \in fps : v = 0 - g
    BY <2>1 DEF AgNegFps
  <2>. QED  BY <2>2, OAAssumption, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>7. \A v \in fps : v > 0
  BY OAAssumption, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7

(***************************************************************************)
(* Actions of a writer outside the eviction region that leave the table    *)
(* alone.                                                                  *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA AgWnPick ==
  ASSUME L # 0, AgD = 0, AgInv, AgInvWn, NEW self \in Writer, pick(self)
  PROVE  AgInvWn'
<1>0. pc[self] = "pick"
  BY DEF pick
<1>1. index[self] \in 0..L
  BY <1>0 DEF AgInvWn, AgWnLoc
<1>2. UNCHANGED << table, external, newexternal, lo, ei, ej, index, expected >>
  BY DEF pick
<1>3. \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "Done"]
      \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "put"]
  BY DEF pick
<1>4. \A w \in Writer : w # self => fp'[w] = fp[w]
  <2>1. fp' = fp \/ \E f \in fps : fp' = [fp EXCEPT ![self] = f]
    BY DEF pick
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1 DEF AgInv
<1>5. \A q \in {"Done", "put"} : AgWnLoc(table, q, index[self], expected[self], fp'[self])
  BY <1>1 DEF AgWnLoc, AgInsPCs, AgScanPCs
<1>6. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "Done"]
  BY <1>0, <1>2, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, AgWnFrame
<1>7. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "put"]
  BY <1>0, <1>2, <1>4, <1>5, <1>7, AgWnFrame
<1>. QED  BY <1>3, <1>6, <1>7

LEMMA AgWnPut ==
  ASSUME L # 0, AgD = 0, AgInv, AgInvWn, NEW self \in Writer, put(self)
  PROVE  AgInvWn'
<1>0. pc[self] = "put"
  BY DEF put
<1>1. index' = [index EXCEPT ![self] = 0] /\ expected' = [expected EXCEPT ![self] = L]
      /\ UNCHANGED << table, external, newexternal, lo, ei, ej, fp >>
  BY DEF put
<1>2. index'[self] = 0 /\ expected'[self] = L
      /\ \A w \in Writer : w # self => index'[w] = index[w] /\ expected'[w] = expected[w]
  BY <1>1 DEF AgInv
<1>3. \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "waitEv"]
      \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "chkSnc"]
  BY DEF put
<1>4. \A q \in {"waitEv", "chkSnc"} : AgWnLoc(table, q, 0, L, fp[self])
  BY OAAssumption DEF AgWnLoc, AgInsPCs, AgScanPCs
<1>5. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "waitEv"]
  BY <1>0, <1>1, <1>2, <1>4, <1>5, AgWnFrame
<1>6. CASE pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "chkSnc"]
  BY <1>0, <1>1, <1>2, <1>4, <1>6, AgWnFrame
<1>. QED  BY <1>3, <1>5, <1>6

LEMMA AgWnKeep ==
  ASSUME L # 0, AgD = 0, AgInv, AgInvWn, NEW self \in Writer, NEW q,
         pc[self] \in {"waitEv", "endWEv", "tryEv", "endEv"},
         q \in {"endWEv", "put", "waitIns"},
         pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = q],
         UNCHANGED << table, external, newexternal, lo, ei, ej, index, expected, fp >>

<1>1. index[self] \in 0..L
  BY DEF AgInvWn, AgWnLoc
<1>2. AgWnLoc(table, q, index[self], expected[self], fp[self])
  BY <1>1 DEF AgWnLoc, AgInsPCs, AgScanPCs
<1>. QED  BY <1>2, AgWnFrame

LEMMA AgWnRtrn ==
  ASSUME L # 0, AgD = 0, AgInv, AgInvWn, NEW self \in Writer, rtrn(self)
  PROVE  AgInvWn'

(* How AgNoDup survives the two ways the table is rewritten during an      *)
(* eviction: a transposition (the insertion sort) and a sign flip (the     *)
(* flush).                                                                 *)

LEMMA AgExceptId ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in [1..K -> AgVals], NEW c \in 1..K
  PROVE  [t EXCEPT ![c] = t[c]] = t
<1>1. [t EXCEPT ![c] = t[c]] \in [1..K -> AgVals]
  OBVIOUS
<1>2. \A x \in 1..K : [t EXCEPT ![c] = t[c]][x] = t[x]
  OBVIOUS
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgNoDupSwap ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in [1..K -> AgVals], NEW a \in 1..K, NEW b \in 1..K, AgNoDup(t)
  PROVE  AgNoDup([t EXCEPT ![a] = t[b], ![b] = t[a]])
<1> DEFINE sw(x) == IF x = a THEN b ELSE IF x = b THEN a ELSE x
<1> DEFINE u == [t EXCEPT ![a] = t[b], ![b] = t[a]]
<1>1. u \in [1..K -> AgVals]
  OBVIOUS
<1>2. \A x \in 1..K : sw(x) \in 1..K
  OBVIOUS
<1>3. \A x \in 1..K : u[x] = t[sw(x)]
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW x \in 1..K PROVE u[x] = t[sw(x)]
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. CASE a = b
    BY <2>2
  <2>3. CASE a # b
    BY <2>3
  <2>. QED  BY <2>2, <2>3
<1>4. \A x, y \in 1..K : sw(x) = sw(y) => x = y
  OBVIOUS
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4 DEF AgNoDup

LEMMA AgNoDupAbs ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in [1..K -> AgVals], NEW c \in 1..K, NEW v \in AgVals,
         v # empty, t[c] # empty, abs(v) = abs(t[c]), AgNoDup(t)
  PROVE  AgNoDup([t EXCEPT ![c] = v])
<1> DEFINE u == [t EXCEPT ![c] = v]
<1>1. u \in [1..K -> AgVals]
  OBVIOUS
<1>2. \A x \in 1..K : u[x] = IF x = c THEN v ELSE t[x]
  OBVIOUS
<1>3. \A x \in 1..K : (u[x] = empty <=> t[x] = empty) /\ abs(u[x]) = abs(t[x])
  BY <1>2
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>3 DEF AgNoDup

LEMMA AgCompNeg ==
