(***************************************************************************)
(* What the window case still needs for Contains and Consistent: nothing   *)
(* appears out of thin air, nothing in history is ever lost, and a         *)
(* fingerprint is never both in the table and in the external log.         *)
(***************************************************************************)
AgIn(q, e) == \E i \in 1..Len(q) : q[i] = e
AgHas(t, f) == \E l \in 0..(L-1) : t[AgCl(l)] = f \/ t[AgCl(l)] = 0 - f

  ASSUME NEW q \in Seq(fps), NEW e
  PROVE  containsElem(q, e) <=> AgIn(q, e)
<1>1. q \in [1..Len(q) -> fps]
  BY AgST!LenProperties
<1>2. DOMAIN q = 1..Len(q)
  BY <1>1
<1>. QED  BY <1>2 DEF containsElem, AgIn

AgInvCn ==
  /\ \A l \in 0..(L-1) :
        /\ (table[AgCl(l)] \in fps => table[AgCl(l)] \in history)
        /\ (table[AgCl(l)] \in AgNegFps => 0 - table[AgCl(l)] \in history)
  /\ \A i \in 1..Len(external) : external[i] \in history
  /\ \A i \in 1..Len(newexternal) : newexternal[i] \in history
  /\ \A w \in Writer : lo[w] \in fps => lo[w] \in history
  /\ \A w \in Writer : \A i \in 1..Len(stack[w]) :
        stack[w][i].lo \in fps => stack[w][i].lo \in history
  /\ \A l \in 0..(L-1) : table[AgCl(l)] \in AgNegFps =>
        AgIn(external, 0 - table[AgCl(l)]) \/ AgIn(newexternal, 0 - table[AgCl(l)])
  /\ \A w \in Writer : lo[w] \in AgNegFps =>
        AgIn(external, 0 - lo[w]) \/ AgIn(newexternal, 0 - lo[w])
  /\ \A w \in Writer : \A i \in 1..Len(stack[w]) :
        stack[w][i].lo \in AgNegFps =>
           AgIn(external, 0 - stack[w][i].lo) \/ AgIn(newexternal, 0 - stack[w][i].lo)
  /\ \A w \in Writer : pc[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"} /\ lo[w] \in fps =>
        ~AgIn(external, lo[w]) /\ ~AgIn(newexternal, lo[w])
  /\ \A f \in history :
        \/ AgHas(table, f)
        \/ AgIn(external, f)
        \/ (\E w \in Writer : pc[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"} /\ lo[w] = f) /\ evict
  /\ \A w \in Writer : pc[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"} =>
        \/ table[AgCl(ej[w] + 1)] = lo[w]
        \/ \E l \in 0..(L-1) : AgCl(l) # AgCl(ej[w] + 1) /\
              table[AgCl(l)] = table[AgCl(ej[w] + 1)]
  /\ \A i \in 1..Len(external) :
        external[i] > largestElem(newexternal) \/ AgIn(newexternal, external[i])
  /\ \A l \in 0..(L-1) : table[AgCl(l)] \in fps =>
        ~AgIn(external, table[AgCl(l)]) /\ ~AgIn(newexternal, table[AgCl(l)])
  /\ \A w \in Writer : pc[w] \in AgInsPCs => ~AgIn(external, fp[w])

  PROVE  x \in history

LEMMA AgCnFrame ==
  ASSUME L # 0, AgD = 0, AgInv, AgInvCn, NEW self \in Writer, NEW q,

  /\ empty \notin AgNegFps
  /\ 0 \notin fps
  /\ 0 \notin AgNegFps

  BY OAAssumption
<1>3. \A g \in fps : 0 - g \in Int /\ 0 - g # 0
  BY <1>2, AgT!SMTT("r30")
<1>4. empty \notin AgNegFps

    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. PICK g \in fps : empty = 0 - g

  <2>. QED  BY <2>2, <1>3, EmptyNotInt
<1>5. 0 \notin AgNegFps
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME 0 \in AgNegFps PROVE FALSE

  <2>2. PICK g \in fps : 0 = 0 - g

  <2>. QED  BY <2>2, <1>3

LEMMA AgFpsNeg == \A x : ~(x \in fps /\ x \in AgNegFps)

<1>2. x \in Nat \ {0}

<1>3. PICK g \in fps : x = 0 - g

<1>4. g \in Nat \ {0}

LEMMA AgSelSeqInF ==
  ASSUME NEW Test(_)
  PROVE  \A q \in Seq(fps) :
            /\ SelectSeq(q, Test) \in Seq(fps)
            /\ \A k \in 1..Len(q) :
                  Test(q[k]) =>
                     \E j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(q, Test)) : SelectSeq(q, Test)[j] = q[k]
  BY AgSelSeqIn

LEMMA AgSelSmallerIn ==
  ASSUME NEW c, NEW d, NEW q \in Seq(fps), NEW k \in 1..Len(q), q[k] < c, q[k] > d
  PROVE  \E j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA pz : pz < c /\ pz > d)) :
            SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA pz : pz < c /\ pz > d)[j] = q[k]

<1>1. \A qq \in Seq(fps) :
        /\ SelectSeq(qq, MyT) \in Seq(fps)
        /\ \A m \in 1..Len(qq) :
              MyT(qq[m]) =>
                 \E j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(qq, MyT)) : SelectSeq(qq, MyT)[j] = qq[m]

<1>. QED  BY <1>1

LEMMA AgSelLargerIn ==

  PROVE  \E j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA pz : pz > d)) :
            SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA pz : pz > d)[j] = q[k]
<1> DEFINE MyT(pz) == pz > d
<1>1. \A qq \in Seq(fps) :
        /\ SelectSeq(qq, MyT) \in Seq(fps)
        /\ \A m \in 1..Len(qq) :
              MyT(qq[m]) =>
                 \E j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(qq, MyT)) : SelectSeq(qq, MyT)[j] = qq[m]

LEMMA AgCnAppSm ==
  ASSUME NEW q \in Seq(fps), NEW r \in Seq(fps), NEW v \in fps,
         AgSIncr(q), AgSIncr(r),
         \A i \in 1..Len(q) : q[i] > largestElem(r) \/ AgIn(r, q[i]),
         ~AgIn(q, v)
  PROVE  /\ largestElem(Append(r \o subSeqSmaller(q, r, v), v)) = v
         /\ AgIn(Append(r \o subSeqSmaller(q, r, v), v), v)
         /\ \A x : AgIn(r, x) => AgIn(Append(r \o subSeqSmaller(q, r, v), v), x)
         /\ \A x : AgIn(Append(r \o subSeqSmaller(q, r, v), v), x) =>
                      AgIn(r, x) \/ AgIn(q, x) \/ x = v
         /\ \A i \in 1..Len(q) :
               q[i] > v \/ AgIn(Append(r \o subSeqSmaller(q, r, v), v), q[i])
<1> DEFINE sel == SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA pz : pz < v /\ pz > largestElem(r))
<1> DEFINE cc == r \o sel
<1> DEFINE nx == Append(cc, v)
<1>ss. subSeqSmaller(q, r, v) = sel
  BY DEF subSeqSmaller
<1> SUFFICES /\ largestElem(nx) = v
             /\ AgIn(nx, v)
             /\ \A x : AgIn(r, x) => AgIn(nx, x)
             /\ \A x : AgIn(nx, x) => AgIn(r, x) \/ AgIn(q, x) \/ x = v
             /\ \A i \in 1..Len(q) : q[i] > v \/ AgIn(nx, q[i])
  BY <1>ss
<1>sel. /\ sel \in Seq(fps)
        /\ \A j \in 1..Len(sel) :
             \E k \in 1..Len(q) :
                sel[j] = q[k] /\ q[k] < v /\ q[k] > largestElem(r)
  BY AgSelSmaller
<1>ln. Len(q) \in Nat /\ Len(r) \in Nat /\ Len(sel) \in Nat
  BY <1>sel, AgST!LenProperties
<1>cc. /\ cc \in Seq(fps)
       /\ Len(cc) = Len(r) + Len(sel)
       /\ \A i \in 1..(Len(r) + Len(sel)) :
             cc[i] = IF i <= Len(r) THEN r[i] ELSE sel[i - Len(r)]
  BY <1>sel, AgST!ConcatProperties
<1>nx. /\ nx \in Seq(fps)
       /\ nx # << >>
       /\ Len(nx) = Len(cc) + 1
       /\ \A i \in 1..Len(cc) : nx[i] = cc[i]
       /\ nx[Len(cc)+1] = v
  BY <1>cc, AgST!AppendProperties
<1>1. largestElem(nx) = v
  <2>1. Len(nx) = Len(cc) + 1 /\ Len(cc) \in Nat
    BY <1>nx, <1>cc, <1>ln
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <1>nx DEF largestElem, last
<1>2. AgIn(nx, v)
  <2>1. (Len(cc) + 1) \in 1..Len(nx) /\ nx[Len(cc)+1] = v
    BY <1>nx, <1>cc, <1>ln
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1 DEF AgIn
<1>3. \A x : AgIn(r, x) => AgIn(nx, x)
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW x, NEW i \in 1..Len(r), r[i] = x PROVE AgIn(nx, x)
    BY DEF AgIn
  <2>2. i \in 1..(Len(r) + Len(sel)) /\ cc[i] = r[i]
    BY <2>1, <1>ln, <1>cc
  <2>3. i \in 1..Len(cc) /\ nx[i] = cc[i] /\ i \in 1..Len(nx)
    BY <2>2, <1>cc, <1>nx, <1>ln
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3 DEF AgIn
<1>4. \A x : AgIn(nx, x) => AgIn(r, x) \/ AgIn(q, x) \/ x = v
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW x, NEW i \in 1..Len(nx), nx[i] = x
                 PROVE  AgIn(r, x) \/ AgIn(q, x) \/ x = v
    BY DEF AgIn
  <2>lc. Len(cc) \in Nat /\ Len(nx) = Len(cc) + 1
    BY <1>cc, <1>ln, <1>nx
  <2>2. CASE i = Len(cc) + 1
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <1>nx
  <2>3. CASE i \in 1..Len(cc)
    <3>1. nx[i] = cc[i] /\ i \in 1..(Len(r) + Len(sel))
      BY <2>3, <1>nx, <1>cc
    <3>2. CASE i <= Len(r)
      <4>1. cc[i] = r[i] /\ i \in 1..Len(r)
        BY <3>1, <3>2, <1>cc, <1>ln
      <4>. QED  BY <2>1, <3>1, <4>1 DEF AgIn
    <3>3. CASE ~(i <= Len(r))

      <4>2. PICK k \in 1..Len(q) : sel[i - Len(r)] = q[k]
        BY <4>1, <1>sel
      <4>. QED  BY <2>1, <3>1, <4>1, <4>2 DEF AgIn
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>lc
<1>5. \A i \in 1..Len(q) : q[i] > v \/ AgIn(nx, q[i])
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(q), ~(q[i] > v) PROVE AgIn(nx, q[i])

  <2>2. q[i] \in fps /\ q[i] \in Int /\ v \in Int

  <2>3. CASE AgIn(r, q[i])

    <3>2. q[i] < v
      BY <2>1, <3>1, <2>2, AgT!SMTT("r30")
    <3>3. PICK j \in 1..Len(sel) : sel[j] = q[i]
      BY <3>2, <2>4, <2>1, AgSelSmallerIn
    <3>4. (Len(r) + j) \in 1..(Len(r) + Len(sel)) /\ cc[Len(r) + j] = sel[j]
      <4>1. (Len(r) + j) \in 1..(Len(r) + Len(sel)) /\ ~(Len(r) + j <= Len(r))
            /\ (Len(r) + j) - Len(r) = j
        BY <3>3, <1>ln, AgT!SMTT("r30")
      <4>. QED  BY <4>1, <1>cc
    <3>5. (Len(r) + j) \in 1..Len(cc) /\ nx[Len(r) + j] = cc[Len(r) + j]
          /\ (Len(r) + j) \in 1..Len(nx)
      BY <3>4, <1>cc, <1>nx, <1>ln
    <3>. QED  BY <3>3, <3>4, <3>5 DEF AgIn
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <2>3, <2>4
<1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5

LEMMA AgCnAppLg ==
  ASSUME NEW q \in Seq(fps), NEW r \in Seq(fps), AgSIncr(q), AgSIncr(r),

         /\ \A x : AgIn(q, x) => AgIn(r \o subSeqLarger(q, r), x)
         /\ \A x : AgIn(r \o subSeqLarger(q, r), x) => AgIn(r, x) \/ AgIn(q, x)

<1>2. CASE r # << >>
  <2> DEFINE sel == SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA pz : pz > largestElem(r))

  <2> SUFFICES /\ r \o sel \in Seq(fps)
               /\ \A x : AgIn(r, x) => AgIn(r \o sel, x)
               /\ \A x : AgIn(q, x) => AgIn(r \o sel, x)

    BY <2>ss
  <2>sel. /\ sel \in Seq(fps)
          /\ \A j \in 1..Len(sel) :

  <2>ln2. Len(sel) \in Nat
    BY <2>sel, AgST!LenProperties
  <2>cc. /\ r \o sel \in Seq(fps)
         /\ Len(r \o sel) = Len(r) + Len(sel)
         /\ \A i \in 1..(Len(r) + Len(sel)) :
               (r \o sel)[i] = IF i <= Len(r) THEN r[i] ELSE sel[i - Len(r)]
    BY <2>sel, AgST!ConcatProperties
  <2>1. \A x : AgIn(r, x) => AgIn(r \o sel, x)
    <3>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW x, NEW i \in 1..Len(r), r[i] = x

    <3>2. i \in 1..(Len(r) + Len(sel)) /\ (r \o sel)[i] = r[i]

    <3>3. i \in 1..Len(r \o sel)

    <3>2. q[i] > largestElem(r)

    <3>3. PICK j \in 1..Len(sel) : sel[j] = q[i]

    <3>4. (Len(r) + j) \in 1..(Len(r) + Len(sel)) /\ ~(Len(r) + j <= Len(r))

  <2>3. \A x : AgIn(r \o sel, x) => AgIn(r, x) \/ AgIn(q, x)

    <3>3. CASE i <= Len(r)

LEMMA AgCnProps ==
  ASSUME L # 0, AgD = 0, AgInv, AgInvEv, AgInvWn, AgInvCn
  PROVE  Contains /\ Consistent
<1>hs. history \in SUBSET fps /\ external \in Seq(fps) /\ newexternal \in Seq(fps)
       /\ lo \in [Writer -> AgVals \cup {0}] /\ table \in [1..K -> AgVals]
  BY DEF AgInv
<1>cL. table[AgCl(L)] = empty
  <2>1. AgCl(L) \in 1..K /\ AgCl(L) \notin AgCells
    BY AgClRange, AgClLOut, OAAssumption
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1 DEF AgInvWn, AgWnTbl
<1>ix. \A x \in Int, l \in Int : idx(x, l) = AgCl(l)
  BY AgIdxCl
<1>lk. L \in Nat \ {0} /\ K \in Nat \ {0} /\ L < K
  BY AgLK
<1>A. \A seen \in history : contains(seen, table, external, L)
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW seen \in history
                 PROVE  contains(seen, table, external, L)
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. seen \in fps /\ seen \in Nat \ {0} /\ seen \in Int
    BY <2>1, <1>hs, OAAssumption
  <2>3. \/ AgHas(table, seen)
        \/ AgIn(external, seen)
        \/ (\E w \in Writer : pc[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"} /\ lo[w] = seen) /\ evict
    BY <2>1 DEF AgInvCn
  <2>4. CASE AgHas(table, seen)
    <3>1. PICK l \in 0..(L-1) : table[AgCl(l)] = seen \/ table[AgCl(l)] = 0 - seen
      BY <2>4 DEF AgHas
    <3>2. l \in 0..L /\ l \in Int
      BY <3>1, <1>lk, AgT!SMTT("r30")
    <3>3. idx(seen, l) = AgCl(l)
      BY <2>2, <3>2, <1>ix
    <3>4. 0 - seen = -1 * seen
      BY <2>2, AgT!SMTT("r30")
    <3>5. isMatch(seen, idx(seen, l), table)
      BY <3>1, <3>3, <3>4 DEF isMatch
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>5 DEF contains
  <2>5. CASE AgIn(external, seen)
    BY <2>5 DEF contains, AgIn
  <2>6. CASE (\E w \in Writer : pc[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"} /\ lo[w] = seen)
             /\ evict
    <3>1. PICK w \in Writer : lo[w] = seen
      BY <2>6
    <3>2. DOMAIN lo = Writer
      BY <1>hs
    <3>3. seen \in { lo[x] : x \in DOMAIN lo }
      BY <3>1, <3>2
    <3>4. seen # 0
      BY <2>2, AgT!SMTT("r30")
    <3>5. evict = TRUE
      BY <2>6
    <3>. QED  BY <3>3, <3>4, <3>5 DEF contains
  <2>. QED  BY <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6
<1>B. \A g \in (fps \ history) : ~contains(g, table, external, L)
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW g \in fps, g \notin history,
                        contains(g, table, external, L)
                 PROVE  FALSE
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. g \in Nat \ {0} /\ g \in Int /\ 0 - g = -1 * g /\ -1 * g \in Int
    BY <2>1, OAAssumption, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>3. \A i \in 0..L : ~isMatch(g, idx(g, i), table)
    <3>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 0..L, isMatch(g, idx(g, i), table) PROVE FALSE
      OBVIOUS
    <3>2. i \in Int
      BY <3>1, <1>lk, AgT!SMTT("r30")
    <3>3. table[AgCl(i)] = g \/ table[AgCl(i)] = -1 * g
      BY <3>1, <3>2, <2>2, <1>ix DEF isMatch
    <3>4. CASE i = L
      <4>1. table[AgCl(i)] = empty
        BY <3>4, <1>cL
      <4>. QED  BY <4>1, <3>3, <2>1, <2>2, AgEmptyOut, EmptyNotInt
    <3>5. CASE i \in 0..(L-1)
      <4>1. /\ (table[AgCl(i)] \in fps => table[AgCl(i)] \in history)
            /\ (table[AgCl(i)] \in AgNegFps => 0 - table[AgCl(i)] \in history)
        BY <3>5 DEF AgInvCn
      <4>2. CASE table[AgCl(i)] = g
        BY <4>2, <4>1, <2>1
      <4>3. CASE table[AgCl(i)] = -1 * g
        <5>1. table[AgCl(i)] \in AgNegFps
          BY <4>3, <2>1, <2>2 DEF AgNegFps
        <5>2. 0 - table[AgCl(i)] = g
          BY <4>3, <2>2, AgT!SMTT("r30")
        <5>. QED  BY <5>1, <5>2, <4>1, <2>1
      <4>. QED  BY <3>3, <4>2, <4>3
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1, <3>4, <3>5, <1>lk, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>4. ~(\E i \in 1..Len(external) : external[i] = g)
    BY <2>1 DEF AgInvCn
  <2>5. g \notin ({ lo[x] : x \in DOMAIN lo } \ {0})
    <3>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW x \in DOMAIN lo, lo[x] = g PROVE FALSE
      OBVIOUS
    <3>2. DOMAIN lo = Writer
      BY <1>hs
    <3>. QED  BY <3>1, <3>2, <2>1 DEF AgInvCn
  <2>. QED  BY <2>1, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5 DEF contains
<1>C. Contains
  BY <1>A, <1>B DEF Contains
<1>D. Consistent
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME evict = FALSE, NEW seen \in history
                 PROVE  /\ containedInTable(seen) => ~containsElem(external, seen)
                        /\ containedInTable(seen * (-1)) => containsElem(external, seen)
                        /\ ~containedInTable(seen) => containsElem(external, seen)
    BY DEF Consistent, FindOrPut
  <2>2. seen \in fps /\ seen \in Nat \ {0} /\ seen \in Int
    BY <2>1, <1>hs, OAAssumption
  <2>3. abs(seen) = seen /\ abs(seen * (-1)) = seen /\ seen * (-1) = 0 - seen
        /\ 0 - seen \in Int
    BY <2>2, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF abs
  <2>ne. newexternal = << >> /\ (\A x : ~AgIn(newexternal, x))
    <3>1. \A w \in Writer : pc[w] # "flush"

        OBVIOUS
      <4>2. evict = TRUE

    <3>2. newexternal = << >>

    <3>3. Len(<< >>) = 0

    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3 DEF AgIn
  <2>ce. \A x : containsElem(external, x) <=> AgIn(external, x)

  <2>ct. \A x \in Int : containedInTable(x) <=> (\E l \in 0..L : table[AgCl(l)] = x)
    <3>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW x \in Int
                   PROVE  containedInTable(x) <=> (\E l \in 0..L : table[AgCl(l)] = x)

    <3>2. abs(x) \in Int
      BY <3>1, AgT!SMTT("r30") DEF abs
    <3>3. \A l \in 0..L : l \in Int
      BY <1>lk, AgT!SMTT("r30")
    <3>4. \A l \in 0..L : idx(abs(x), l) = AgCl(l)
      BY <3>2, <3>3, <1>ix
    <3>. QED  BY <3>4 DEF containedInTable
  <2>nL. table[AgCl(L)] # seen /\ table[AgCl(L)] # 0 - seen
    BY <1>cL, <2>2, <2>3, AgEmptyOut, EmptyNotInt
  <2>ll. \A l \in 0..L : l # L => l \in 0..(L-1)
    BY <1>lk, AgT!SMTT("r30")
  <2>6. \A l \in 0..L : table[AgCl(l)] = 0 - seen => AgIn(external, seen)
    <3>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW l \in 0..L, table[AgCl(l)] = 0 - seen
                   PROVE  AgIn(external, seen)
      OBVIOUS
    <3>2. l \in 0..(L-1)
      BY <3>1, <2>nL, <2>ll
    <3>3. table[AgCl(l)] \in AgNegFps
      BY <3>1, <2>2 DEF AgNegFps
    <3>4. 0 - table[AgCl(l)] = seen
      BY <3>1, <2>2, AgT!SMTT("r30")
    <3>5. AgIn(external, 0 - table[AgCl(l)]) \/ AgIn(newexternal, 0 - table[AgCl(l)])
      BY <3>2, <3>3 DEF AgInvCn
    <3>. QED  BY <3>4, <3>5, <2>ne
  <2>7. containedInTable(seen) => ~containsElem(external, seen)
    <3>1. SUFFICES ASSUME containedInTable(seen) PROVE ~AgIn(external, seen)
      BY <2>ce
    <3>2. PICK l \in 0..L : table[AgCl(l)] = seen
      BY <3>1, <2>ct, <2>2
    <3>3. l \in 0..(L-1)
      BY <3>2, <2>nL, <2>ll
    <3>. QED  BY <3>2, <3>3, <2>2 DEF AgInvCn
  <2>8. containedInTable(seen * (-1)) => containsElem(external, seen)
    <3>1. SUFFICES ASSUME containedInTable(seen * (-1)) PROVE AgIn(external, seen)

    <3>2. seen * (-1) \in Int

    <3>3. PICK l \in 0..L : table[AgCl(l)] = seen * (-1)

    <3>. QED  BY <3>3, <2>3, <2>6
  <2>9. ~containedInTable(seen) => containsElem(external, seen)
    <3>1. SUFFICES ASSUME ~containedInTable(seen) PROVE AgIn(external, seen)
      BY <2>ce
    <3>2. \/ AgHas(table, seen)
          \/ AgIn(external, seen)
          \/ (\E w \in Writer : pc[w] \in {"nestedIns", "set"} /\ lo[w] = seen)

    <3>3. SUFFICES ASSUME AgHas(table, seen) PROVE AgIn(external, seen)

    <3>4. PICK l \in 0..(L-1) : table[AgCl(l)] = seen \/ table[AgCl(l)] = 0 - seen

    <3>5. l \in 0..L

    <3>6. table[AgCl(l)] # seen

    <3>. QED  BY <3>4, <3>5, <3>6, <2>6
